Have you ever stopped to think about how charitable giving is a brilliant reflection of freedom?

It's a way for every American to use our hard-earned money to freely support the causes we care most about.

This is democracy in action: because every dollar you give is a vote for the future you want to see.

I'd like to personally invite you to join me in advancing common-sense solutions to our nation's toughest challenges by [making a generous gift of whatever your budget allows.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b8e5407eb62e49689b3693b48c710374&_e=v3zSxGjfiUlrPaKGkkzhtetixcZAQbVx41PbnLXhlNW_TVvuI8rMMEaLSMfbtUYo0MzGYPr1zpyKTw1WFS1OL2b0BIoMtCgHWk7lm14aiXHVk3enKzA8Agjut9cu1EZqRyM4vcZ9iYNK_6p1rBlJeANS7GoSv8dSEFIJvqhlCYFULw32P1l8JP3lBAA9xkWmKJRLJjoBuV-kplPM9inAlxlmwMtwhqdf9z16kIIGFEy4y3pm9Vh92zN9ZE_9qnaIw5t9GHkA8LNmLe0UgQONYenqvi8MOM-EgkIO_AY7jrgBmS2Q2LSC-2oQmW6HWWHC86rJ2k26hWsY8PJysEOpKGvB4mm_JGpzH59v2DLr7z8u9TvT10B9Fy_RZjZJdkd3QMxBg6y4dqivZNm5bTmC_A%3D%3D)

Your investment will allow the American Cornerstone Institute to engage in independent research, grassroots outreach, and collaboration with conservative leaders to set forth a better path forward for our country, safeguarding freedom for you and your family in the coming years.

Will you join me? If so, you can support these efforts by clicking the link below:

[https://secure.americancornerstone.org/donate](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b8e5407eb62e49689b3693b48c710374&_e=v3zSxGjfiUlrPaKGkkzhtetixcZAQbVx41PbnLXhlNW_TVvuI8rMMEaLSMfbtUYo0MzGYPr1zpyKTw1WFS1OL2b0BIoMtCgHWk7lm14aiXHVk3enKzA8Agjut9cu1EZqRyM4vcZ9iYNK_6p1rBlJeANS7GoSv8dSEFIJvqhlCYFULw32P1l8JP3lBAA9xkWmKJRLJjoBuV-kplPM9inAlxlmwMtwhqdf9z16kIIGFExJZDhfTY9mLNbjhodSAWJkAuUtwWQ2ShAvpl3vuuae75IFMO2I5BiH1jWOIM-JQ0cg5AZqxBRUC3ex3CszliCnWjoz5PQkPj6-G9D0qlx0dWT4vzrFs4gP3UZW6WZTg83aOPFFE8hGW0tY6ovGIEuQAEeDLHI3IMg2q8V9VEGyow%3D%3D)

Where the Left wants bigger government, we'll fight for limited government and self-determination.

America is the greatest country that has ever existed. Please help me do everything possible to make sure it stays that way.

subject: We can win back the House, but we can’t do it without you
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
Friends,

Look, I’ll get right to it: Winning back the House from Trump’s MAGA minions is going to be a very tight battle. It’s looking more and more like the road to the speakership is through Long Island and NY-1. The bottom line: Democrats can’t afford to lose this fight.

We’re building a campaign to win. We’re off to a strong start, but we have to keep up the momentum. Can I count on you to pitch in before our end-of-quarter deadline and ensure we have the resources we need to take back this seat? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-em0322?refcode=em0328]

Democrats across Suffolk County are coming together. From former state senator Jim Gaughran to former Congressional candidate Bridget Fleming, I’m humbled by crucial endorsements from those who know the district best – even former candidates for this seat themselves. That speaks to just how solid our momentum is. We all know we have to unite and give Democrats the best possible chance to win this seat.

It’s time to take the fight to Trump’s MAGA minions. That means holding them to account for their repeated assaults on women’s reproductive freedoms – like a national abortion ban. It means reminding voters that Trump’s congressional flunkies torpedoed a bipartisan immigration bill that conservatives wanted. And it means presenting common sense solutions to actually help Suffolk County families and strengthen the middle class – like bringing back the Child Tax Credit and state and local tax deductions.

That’s how you build a winning coalition. Our best chance this fall is to take Trump flunky Nick LaLota (or George Santos) head on. To do that, it’s going to take all of us.
I know we can win this fight. But I can’t do it alone. This movement is powered by people like you pitching in one donation at a time to make sure we win this seat and Democrats take back the House. Are you with me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-em0322?refcode=em0328]

Thank you for fighting the good fight with me.
-John

name: Lisa Blunt Rochester
subject: This is a longer, more personal message from me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250 [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250] [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Hi there, it's Lisa Blunt Rocheste r – do you have a sec?
I know our campaign for Senate means a lot to so many people. The significance of it isn't lost on me – especially as we celebrate Women’s History Month – and I'm fighting hard to make sure we win in November. So before I go on, can I ask that you chip in $10 or more to our campaign to help us do just that? [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
CHIP IN $10 >> [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr&amount=10]
CHIP IN MORE >> [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
This Women’s History Month, and every single day beyond, I celebrate all of the women who are stepping up to make a difference in the face of some of the most critical challenges our planet is facing. The stakes are so high, and so many women aren’t just helping tackle these challenges, but they are leading the charge on solving them.
From moms demanding action on gun violence to young women standing up for our planet, women are creating positive change everywhere. In Congress, I am working to protect our reproductive freedoms, close the racial gap in maternal mortality rates, and shine a spotlight on menopause health and awareness.
With all that’s at stake in 2024, this race means a lot to so many people across the country.
http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250 [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
This race means a lot to me, too. Especially younger me.
I grew up knowing very few role models that looked like me in government, so I made it my mission to change that. When I set my mind to something, it gets done.
As I reflect during Women’s History Month, I can't help but to look back at my younger self and think of what helped me get here. It's the support from so many women – role models, family members, friends, and so many more – who helped me feel empowered to lead in Congress, and now run for Senate.
We need to continue to invest in women because when women are empowered, the world is a better place. Our world, our power.
Invest in women so we can continue to make a positive impact on our country, friend. But in order to win, I'll need some serious help. Will you contribute any amount you can between our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand's to help us keep Delaware and the Senate blue in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=10]
If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Lisa Blunt Rochester and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately:

ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_lbr?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
With you,
Lisa

Peter — Scott here, Tammy’s campaign manager. We just increased our grassroots fundraising goal with only a few days to go before the deadline. **[I’m going to ask you to chip in to help us close the gap in a moment](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-mar24.lt590f&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20240328_PM2_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2319%2E35263%2EcZ94VI)** , but first I want to explain why. subject: The Mountain Minute: 3/28/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| |
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| Hello, Head over to[ our Twitter ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)for live updates from the convention to vote for the Republican candidates in[ CD4's special elecion](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to replace Ken Buck (keep reading for the winner). This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 28, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**BREAKING NEWS: Greg Lopez chosen as the nominee in special election for Ken Buck's congressional seat**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [BY RMV STAFF](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
See our full coverage of [tonight's convention](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to pick a nominee for the special election to fill Ken Buck's vacant US House seat. Our editor, Brian Porter, [reported live](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as Republicans went through six rounds of voting to come to the final nominee, Greg Lopez. Stay tuned for a full article on the special election and tonight's convention tomorrow. **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**Democrats work to erase the biggest school choice option in Colorado**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Proposed Colorado [House Bill 24-1363](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) aims to significantly undermine charter schools in Colorado. The bill, introduced by Democratic lawmakers, seeks to [dismantle charter autonomy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and impose stringent regulations.

* Provisions in the bill include [dictating demographics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for charter school boards, limiting charter school appeals processes, and allowing local school boards to deny charter applications without valid reasons.

* The bill also introduces [barriers for both new and existing charter schools](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), potentially leading to the closure of schools serving hundreds or thousands of students. Critics argue that the bill represents a grave threat to parental choice in education and call for its defeat in the state legislature.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Staff at taxpayer-funded Colorado virus lab were bitten by Covid-infected hamsters and disease-ridden bats, records show**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[DAILY MAIL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* [Exclusive documents](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) reveal a shocking number of safety incidents at a taxpayer-funded virus lab in Colorado. The lab, located at Colorado State University, experienced at least [50 accidents](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) between 2020 and 2023.

* Incidents included staff being bitten by COVID-infected hamsters, splashed with blood from mice with tuberculosis, and scratched by rabies-infected cats.

* Despite occurring during the COVID pandemic, these reports were [not disclosed to the public](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The accidents raise concerns about lab safety protocols, especially considering the potential risks associated with handling deadly viruses.

* Check out [Episode #9 of Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to learn more about the questionable research they're doing at CSU.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**FTX Founder Sam Bankman-Fried Sentenced to 25 Years in Prison for Fraud**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE EPOCH TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Sam Bankman-Fried, founder of FTX, has been [sentenced to 25 years in prison ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)for defrauding investors of $8 billion through the now-bankrupt cryptocurrency exchange.

* U.S. District Judge Lewis Kaplan handed down the sentence after rejecting Bankman-Fried’s claim that FTX customers [did not actually lose money](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The judge ordered forfeiture of $11.2 billion but did not order restitution, citing impracticality due to the number of victims.

* Bankman-Fried's[ lack of remorse](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) was a point of concern for the judge, who emphasized the massive scale of the criminality involved. The conviction stemmed from a Coindesk report in November 2022, which raised concerns about FTX's finances, leading to a run on the exchange and the loss of billions in customer funds.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Krannawitter: We need a reminder of what is good and beautiful. Baseball is that reminder.**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[DR. KRANNAWITTER'S SUBSTACK](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Few things are more American than baseball, and this is Opening Day. Many modern sports have historic roots either in royalty, aristocracy, and political privilege, or uncivilized savagery. Early golf, like fox hunting, required sprawling tracts of land that was typically owned by a crowned sovereign and managed by royal “landlords.” American football owes much to rugby, which in medieval Europe was a kind of rule-less, tribal, mob warfare between neighboring villages that featured bare-knuckled brawls and sometimes even murder. [**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** **[Candidates quizzed on new issues in Douglas County GOP Women’s forum; Flora wins 64% of straw poll vote](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | MARCH 28** _LONE TREE — A smaller collection of Republican candidates vying for the 4th District seat in the U.S. House offered potential delegates and voters an opportunity to get into more detail Wednesday here during the Douglas County Republican Women’s forum._ **[The Last Gasp of the Liberal Colorado Press](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY HEIDI GANAHL | STATE | MARCH 27** _Gov. Jared Polis and his cronies are very mad that a real newsman is doing the job they refuse to do. We started Rocky Mountain Voice to report factual, real news, to allow Coloradans to have the knowledge to make better decisions — in government and culture, all in one place. We thought they’d eventually be scared of us, but we didn’t realize the establishment media would be quaking in their boots within the first two months!_ [**George Brauchler qualifies for ballot in 23rd Judicial District**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | MARCH 27** _George Brauchler has qualified for a place on the Republican Party’s primary ballot for district attorney in the 23rd Judicial District, the Secretary of State’s office announced Wednesday, March 27, in an email._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)[@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
# 🏟️ DID YOU KNOW?

In honor of opening day for baseball season, here's a fun fact about Coors Field! Due to the high altitude and thinner air, Coors Field is known for producing high-scoring games. The combination of the ball traveling further and having less resistance in the air leads to an offensive-friendly environment. Go Rockies! ⚾️

name: Trump Train News
subject: Consider...
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z151n5bofpqk6j7h6qkfar9rp80op2vnhgj04lqg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctg66ob7cjh2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvpgdrl64srvjd34vhjk208hgtpk3tmrequubgf8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctg66ob7cjh2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfdga6jqmalf86pgfmqeu8uveesjgh3fjuo1r6fg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctg66ob7cjh2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Trump Train News

name: VRF Election Operations Team
subject: Who’s ERIC and why are they destroying our election?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voter Reference Foundation |
body:
ERIC claims to “improve the accuracy of voter registration rolls”, but in reality, it does the complete opposite.

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfrod1m5a6n495e8onvjj70obdcf0anmn28c69ag_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctg66pr6c1h2bs)
---
Fellow Patriot, Today we need to tell you about one of the biggest risks to our elections: The Electronic Registration Information Center (ERIC). Driven by an intense partisan bias that undermines the integrity of our elections, ERIC is a threat to our entire electoral process.

**The organization claims to “improve the accuracy of voter registration rolls,” but in reality, it does the complete opposite. **

---
[**HELP FIGHT AGAINST ERIC**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zshv87aia5upago7skiv2vr820t9cmle4ohc7gb0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctg66pr6c1h2bs)
---
Voter rolls were **NEVER** designed to be maintained by some shadowy partisan effort hidden behind closed doors. They are and always have been designed for us, The People, to monitor - as explicitly outlined in the Motor Voter Act. **Here's why ERIC's agenda is so concerning:**
1. **Lack of Transparency:** ERIC operates behind closed doors, shielded from public scrutiny. This opacity raises serious doubts about the organization's intentions and impact on our electoral process.
2. **Privacy Concerns:** ERIC's data-sharing practices compromise the privacy of voters by indiscriminately collecting and disseminating sensitive information across state lines.
3. **Partisan Bias:** ERIC's methods for "cleaning" voter rolls are riddled with partisan bias, resulting in the purging of legitimate voters from registration lists. This systematic disenfranchisement undermines the fundamental principles of democracy.**

**ERIC is already active in several states, with others at risk of joining its ranks. Fellow Patriot, we cannot allow ERIC to continue its unopposed assault on election integrity.** The good news is that Voter Reference Foundation has been closely following ERIC - and we have _successfully_ fought against it....
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0j2k6s0vuii8hn8v6ev85nvptlj6i8pkptp6lh8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctg66pr6c1h2bs)
---
| | **In Virginia, we recently scored a significant victory as Governor Glenn Youngkin vetoed a Democrat-pushed bill (SB 606) aimed at forcing the commonwealth back into ERIC.**

This decision is a step in the right direction, _but it's just one battle in a much larger war._

Our efforts to keep our election system out of ERIC's grip have been tireless, and while we've made strides, there's still so much work to be done. ERIC continues to pose a grave threat to election integrity, and the fight against it is far from over.

But, with your support, we can continue our advocacy efforts, push back against ERIC's influence, and defend the integrity of our elections nationwide.

**Will you join us in this critical fight? Your donation will help us keep up the momentum.**

[**Donate now to stand with us against ERIC and protect the integrity of our elections.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1vt4qlke9s8fhfr5j3g08q8mfstvlhud2kerr2g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctg66pr6c1h2bs)

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31342%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Fwo5TKcZm6uexW2qu6fXlA&sysid=1) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31343%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=O538rWDkLkKUI0irVeOLYQ&sysid=1) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer “sound learning” in order to preserve “the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty.”** Yet today’s ruling class mocks people of faith as “backward,” “bigots,” and even “Christo-fascists.” Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you “get bitter” and “cling to guns or religion.” These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today’s government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That’s why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include “Inside the Transgender Empire” by Christopher F. Rufo, “The Most Important Decision in Life” by Bishop Robert Barron, and “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including “The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,” “Ancient Christianity,” and “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”) consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we’ve seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31343%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=O538rWDkLkKUI0irVeOLYQ&sysid=1) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Your America News

body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Freedom Liberty Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT8PmzAQxT-N2YyMz0AYGCIRpiSt2qEjMvZBLPkPsk2rfPuKlnTuenfv_e7d_XhMD2ms8etTOuwXG6eYJi-nl7GWRrQ07ZH6YNw6ccYFZUB5N_FC96zqtBAF9lVbVS0DqKB49dCBalULF5hl2-l5rivWaM2gU4J1F1WY_vBhwDvWiqaGUkHNNS5ynhchOONEMGkx5nKJiDo46bU1M8b8jriFmEsVXGH7V85bInAlfCR8tFt5bJy0tFii3gkfI1qzmrAnesqPKD_xfQhgTIrAwCpew5Nxwe_sOnwZbrfvhDd7dlMKe1RIYNhiSBuqbPx6thxqszsCAzpp7FlU0m3SrJ7A8I97Yj_Uv3PBZ_SZwPD1Ssf7N_o5RhF7vf0y1prUtESw9TD_EzX__1d-BwAA___TSJZt) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT8PmzAQxT-N2YyMz0AYGCIRpiSt2qEjMvZBLPkPsk2rfPuKlnTuenfv_e7d_XhMD2ms8etTOuwXG6eYJi-nl7GWRrQ07ZH6YNw6ccYFZUB5N_FC96zqtBAF9lVbVS0DqKB49dCBalULF5hl2-l5rivWaM2gU4J1F1WY_vBhwDvWiqaGUkHNNS5ynhchOONEMGkx5nKJiDo46bU1M8b8jriFmEsVXGH7V85bInAlfCR8tFt5bJy0tFii3gkfI1qzmrAnesqPKD_xfQhgTIrAwCpew5Nxwe_sOnwZbrfvhDd7dlMKe1RIYNhiSBuqbPx6thxqszsCAzpp7FlU0m3SrJ7A8I97Yj_Uv3PBZ_SZwPD1Ssf7N_o5RhF7vf0y1prUtESw9TD_EzX__1d-BwAA___TSJZt) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkT8PmzAQxT-N2YyMz0AYGCIRpiSt2qEjMvZBLPkPsk2rfPuKlnTuenfv_e7d_XhMD2ms8etTOuwXG6eYJi-nl7GWRrQ07ZH6YNw6ccYFZUB5N_FC96zqtBAF9lVbVS0DqKB49dCBalULF5hl2-l5rivWaM2gU4J1F1WY_vBhwDvWiqaGUkHNNS5ynhchOONEMGkx5nKJiDo46bU1M8b8jriFmEsVXGH7V85bInAlfCR8tFt5bJy0tFii3gkfI1qzmrAnesqPKD_xfQhgTIrAwCpew5Nxwe_sOnwZbrfvhDd7dlMKe1RIYNhiSBuqbPx6thxqszsCAzpp7FlU0m3SrJ7A8I97Yj_Uv3PBZ_SZwPD1Ssf7N_o5RhF7vf0y1prUtESw9TD_EzX__1d-BwAA___TSJZt) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

body:
ERIC claims to “improve the accuracy of voter registration rolls”, but in reality, it does the complete opposite.

| | | [](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyU0bGOnTAQBdCvMZ3R2AYMBUWUp9dEmyJNSmsYBp61xkbGEOXvI5LsB2w5p7hXuvPzzb2hDz6u33Hj8Z2yy4fz28ruyosMv31cZUlyQWKnQTcSjNSDM9U8zgN12FU8KquUhVYpU73GYZhU37ctG6v0wr0CXFrDZKdp5p7byo93Dhg9gG0smJpoIUOo-4GmWWkSDWDgXOp35p1SXDMfR-b9nIInjDWlrQrjq5T9EOaL0E-hn1cqnGXmhTNHYrmkM85YfIp15uuqKQn9RLpB3vUc-N-x4x1gnmfZ3JHOTCzM48bulo1nf27CPHj_L4Tbjn6NwjwyX8cLM8s97UgF5Yxx5XzItEjOnlwBAGUvANtaBLC2DQC2UwRgrDkBur5xEV38qCskzOPb1x_yY6Eqj_P-y4fgj86KBtYNffg7QPnEr_4EAAD__yYSnJk)
---
Fellow Patriot, Today we need to tell you about one of the biggest risks to our elections: The Electronic Registration Information Center (ERIC). Driven by an intense partisan bias that undermines the integrity of our elections, ERIC is a threat to our entire electoral process.

**The organization claims to “improve the accuracy of voter registration rolls,” but in reality, it does the complete opposite. **

---
[**HELP FIGHT AGAINST ERIC**](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyU0bGOnTAQBdCvMZ3R2AYMBUWUp9dEmyJNSmsYBp61xkbGEOXvI5LsB2w5p7hXuvPzzb2hDz6u33Hj8Z2yy4fz28ruyosMv31cZUlyQWKnQTcSjNSDM9U8zgN12FU8KquUhVYpU73GYZhU37ctG6v0wr0CXFrDZKdp5p7byo93Dhg9gG0smJpoIUOo-4GmWWkSDWDgXOp35p1SXDMfR-b9nIInjDWlrQrjq5T9EOaL0E-hn1cqnGXmhTNHYrmkM85YfIp15uuqKQn9RLpB3vUc-N-x4x1gnmfZ3JHOTCzM48bulo1nf27CPHj_L4Tbjn6NwjwyX8cLM8s97UgF5Yxx5XzItEjOnlwBAGUvANtaBLC2DQC2UwRgrDkBur5xEV38qCskzOPb1x_yY6Eqj_P-y4fgj86KBtYNffg7QPnEr_4EAAD__yYSnJk)
---
Voter rolls were **NEVER** designed to be maintained by some shadowy partisan effort hidden behind closed doors. They are and always have been designed for us, The People, to monitor - as explicitly outlined in the Motor Voter Act. **Here's why ERIC's agenda is so concerning:**
1. **Lack of Transparency:** ERIC operates behind closed doors, shielded from public scrutiny. This opacity raises serious doubts about the organization's intentions and impact on our electoral process.
2. **Privacy Concerns:** ERIC's data-sharing practices compromise the privacy of voters by indiscriminately collecting and disseminating sensitive information across state lines.
3. **Partisan Bias:** ERIC's methods for "cleaning" voter rolls are riddled with partisan bias, resulting in the purging of legitimate voters from registration lists. This systematic disenfranchisement undermines the fundamental principles of democracy.**

**ERIC is already active in several states, with others at risk of joining its ranks. Fellow Patriot, we cannot allow ERIC to continue its unopposed assault on election integrity.** The good news is that Voter Reference Foundation has been closely following ERIC - and we have _successfully_ fought against it....
---
[](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyU0bGOnTAQBdCvMZ3R2AYMBUWUp9dEmyJNSmsYBp61xkbGEOXvI5LsB2w5p7hXuvPzzb2hDz6u33Hj8Z2yy4fz28ruyosMv31cZUlyQWKnQTcSjNSDM9U8zgN12FU8KquUhVYpU73GYZhU37ctG6v0wr0CXFrDZKdp5p7byo93Dhg9gG0smJpoIUOo-4GmWWkSDWDgXOp35p1SXDMfR-b9nIInjDWlrQrjq5T9EOaL0E-hn1cqnGXmhTNHYrmkM85YfIp15uuqKQn9RLpB3vUc-N-x4x1gnmfZ3JHOTCzM48bulo1nf27CPHj_L4Tbjn6NwjwyX8cLM8s97UgF5Yxx5XzItEjOnlwBAGUvANtaBLC2DQC2UwRgrDkBur5xEV38qCskzOPb1x_yY6Eqj_P-y4fgj86KBtYNffg7QPnEr_4EAAD__yYSnJk)

body:
The stakes for the lives of the unborn couldn’t be any higher.

Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America
__
Stop the Biden Administration's radical abortion agenda! | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31463%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9iddoLjfq1IifBF6Dl1Rlg&sysid=1)

| |
Fellow Americans,

We still have several months before the 2024 election, but the battle lines have been clearly drawn and now we have a critical task to do.

**The stakes for the lives of the unborn couldn’t be any higher.**

The truth is that the best way for me and you to serve women and save babies is for all pro-life supporters to throw our entire weight behind pro-life candidates. Seriously.

And protecting the innocent lives of the unborn doesn’t start and end with who occupies the White House in January of next year.

At the end of the day, if Congress isn’t full of pro-life lawmakers, then there won’t be any legislation to sign into law that will protect women from the dangers of abortion or the innocent lives of millions of babies who will be slaughtered through this deadly industry in the years and decades to come.

**It sounds clich e to say that this election is the most important one of our lives, but it absolutely is true.**

The overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ was an important step in protecting the innocent lives murdered by Big Abortion, but it was just the first step in the process.

Let’s be honest... the pro-life movement has lost key battles at the state level to radicals who want abortion to be legal up until the moment of birth.

**The pendulum must swing back the other way.**

The Supreme Court decided to return the decision to the states, but Congress still has the power to write laws that federally mandate strict controls over what kind of laws they can write on this subject.

What does that mean exactly? It means that a minimum of a federal 15-week pain-capable limit is still possible.

The best part? _**About 70% of Americans say that they would support it.**_

We just need to fill Congress with enough pro-life lawmakers to be bold enough to push for it.

That’s why I’m writing to you today.

The truth is that there are a lot of pro-life organizations that do fine work in the movement today, but there isn’t anyone better positioned than SBA to get this job done.

We are the only pro-life organization that has the infrastructure to actually make a difference in elections this November. On top of that, we have a laser-focused and targeted strategy to get the job done. How?

We have been working tirelessly for more than a year now to:
* Identify strong pro-life champions who will win elections in vulnerable House and Senate seats this Fall by running on platforms to protect the unborn.
* Actively coach and equip those candidates with strong talking points and defensible positions that will persuade voters to vote for them because of the pro-life positions they take.
* Help them to develop strong policy prescriptions that have compassion for women and a desire to offer care options instead of leaving vulnerable mothers to succumb to the abortion industry’s lies (which would have them kill their unborn child instead).
* Help them to advocate for stronger protections for pregnancy centers against the onslaught of leftist attacks from Planned Parenthood radicals and fanatics.
* Provide them with world-class scientific research that proves the dangers of poisonous abortion drugs to mothers and their children, and the truth about the existence of human life present in the mother’s womb from the moment of conception.

We are all-in on this year's election -- AND -- on protecting the lives of the unborn against the radical left’s culture of death once and for all!

**There’s just one problem, Friend ...**

To keep this massive war machine in operation, we must hit specific fundraising goals each and every day.

Unfortunately, we have fallen behind the pace that we need to keep everything fully operational and on track to win in November.

**The truth is that I need another 10 donors to make a gift before the end of the day.**

Do you think that you could be one of those 10?

If so, would you take a moment right now to make your donation online at this secure donation form?

[https://secure.sbaprolife.org/election-planning](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31464%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hm7lYb41%2bH9hkigvT%2fHkHw&sysid=1)

If you can make a donation today, I’ll be sure to keep you updated on the progress being made through the SBA Pro-Life America Field Team, share the latest updates within our fight for life, and let you know of key decisions and actions you can take as a passionate pro-life champion.

Thank you so much for considering this request today.

Your generous support is certain to save many, many unborn lives.

Thank you again and I hope that you have a wonderful rest of your day.

For Life,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, SBA Pro-Life America

Fellow Conservative,

Most Americans know very little about America's founding.

In today's public schools, instead of learning about our Founding Fathers and the U.S. Constitution's principles, they are brainwashed with transgender ideology.

At The Heritage Foundation, we're dedicated to creating conservative policy solutions that will defend and sustain our republic. But if our country is to survive, the American people must know our founding principles and the history that brought it about.

**That's why my team at The Heritage Foundation is also committed to teaching the public about American history and our Founding Fathers.**

We published our _Founders' Almanac_ for this exact purpose.

This informative book contains biographical essays about our Founding Fathers like George Washington, Benjamin Franklin, and John Adams along with insightful analysis of primary sources like the Declaration of Independence, the United States Constitution, and Washington's Farewell Address.

**To help further your knowledge of American history, I'd like to offer you a free digital copy of Heritage's _Founders' Almanac_.**

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GUCQwc4XxaUB2jw-Bh3uCw~~/AARclAA~/RgRn6RywP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzI5VwNzcGNCCmYELIAGZlgUFRJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/GUCQwc4XxaUB2jw-Bh3uCw~~/AARclAA~/RgRn6RywP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMzI5VwNzcGNCCmYELIAGZlgUFRJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. **Good Morning**! On this date in 1951, Julius and Ethel Rosenberg were convicted of espionage for their role in passing atomic secrets to the Soviet Union. They were the only spies executed during the Cold War. ([See Photo](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFu6yAUgOGnwRsWHBMIA8NdvOWuHS0CB_tUBCJAsfL2VauOnb_hl_6P23bzlKns__0D3Uh182HQC7eFg-WgNjVFlxABlwmdNFIaacEs0-EERK8jBAn3i072DogYpQmo4arlVUzkQIASC1hhL3oxs1ZBBWNDinC9BIFMCYw0aps_K5VxYMrv-sI2h_qYsjvGeHa2_GOwMljP85wP6qO297czWMdBnUf_5lT4rzBYW-1Y7tj2zkMtLwoDI6-JY39SLX7Hqbn4PCln6towJfaHp_yTHH8O-AoAAP__Hqde0g)) A favorite part of our week is producing the Feel Good Friday section, highlighting stories of courage, generosity, and love. Today, it also includes parrots cooing like humans to their babies, [a video not to be missed.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7-OrCAUgPGngU6DBxQpKG4z3dx2S8Ofw3g2KAZZzbz9Zrfe_suX_D6ey9NRpv31321oWyqLC40uXGQHpgO1KB5tQgSUHO2gh0EPBrTkq_XCaxlHn5LRmBAnOYfRJDerNPk5AicLApSQYIQZJ6n7SQUVtAkpwjwGgUwJjNRK7T8L7W3FlN_lwtqHsvFs19aOk8l_DB4MHvd991_HXWpb3z8Bg8fhai2ty-Wi_dWVvfPOE5682njclDOdk2ZKvDZH-ffZ_hR-BwAA__-gpVPg) Have a great weekend, everyone! |

## White House Orders Federal AI Safeguards
The White House ordered all federal agencies to name ["Chief Artificial Intelligence Officers"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D9vwyAUBPBPgzcs_sXEA0PVyluydrSe4RFehU1kaKx--8qdu530G-50n7f5BpRpe9xhRddimcE3euGsuRq5MrPpgouICnWHTloprRyV1V1yaC8CpL3qwcTFLnbBoCxKGMZgLQjZkVNCGaHVKMbLoG0_GG-8HX0M6nrxApkRGKiVvf8qtLWEMf-UF-69L2uXXWrtWZl-Y2piajqOo_dL3fCopzM1nfGERA15Kt8VuU-EkQPxEiN53CuPGHCHzOGBmyesHPZGkTxB5rQ1zJlOwbNET7Q1T4Hpj_f7jQvBpYAlyNTtLjwPypnqYJkRjxUo_61s_372GwAA__9M_27F) to oversee the government's use and oversight of AI. The directive also calls for agencies to set up governance boards to establish rules for the government's use of AI and to implement what the White House calls "concrete safeguards" to ensure safety. As an example, the White House said new safeguards will ensure that air travelers [can opt out of TSA facial recognition](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOrCAUxvGnwQ6DBxAtKG5jN7fd0rB41LNBmAUcM2-_ceutv-TLL_-Px_xwFChu_92Btq5pdr7SC2fJYeSgZtUsdkUElA3aznSd6UYwstltB2bxZtDayxVdL6TS-hO99EM_dM7ohiwIUELCKEbdS9P2yitvRr8uMGgvkCmBC9WU269Ese64hnd6YW59Oppg91qfhcl_DCYG03VdbcazYi73zmCq6PeYQtreDKaz8IzfJ2WKG494cUe8uBW30-Wl8O3-jQfGys-CvGYXy9NljP7NbyUXksPAYGqyXZ4XhUClN0yJ7XAUfkH1zzw_AQAA__91UGfT) use at airport security checkpoints without a delay in screening.
## Bankman-Fried Gets 25 Years in Prison
Former cryptocurrency entrepreneur [Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fu6yAUxvGngQ0LDmDigeEu3nLXjhaBQ3xajCOD4vbtq2Tu9km_4dP_47pcAxWq9_9hQ9_zvoTY6YmLFjAJMIvhyWdEQM3RK6eUUxM4zVev7UXeVLYqjjI7O9lRO-lcxmAT6Cw5eZBgpIZJvnEYTTTRTTEnuNgokRmJifp-DJ871b5iLj_7E48h7hsvfu390Zj-x2BmMJ_nOcRbq3i2lzOYX5PB3MImbqF-baGKfBAm0bB2rJHqXeT-zWDmh0-Pk0qhNjpm5H0LVN4v_c_m3wAAAP__eppYOw) to 25 years in prison Thursday for embezzling billions of dollars from customers. Bankman-Fried, founder of digital currency exchange FTX, was convicted in November of seven counts of fraud, money laundering, and conspiracy to commit fraud and faced up to 110 years in prison. Prosecutors asked for a sentence between 40 and 50 years, while Bankman-Fried lawyers asked for only 6-1/2 years. The judge settled on 25 years, saying it was a "[significant period of time.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy4yAQQL9G6vDAshKmoLjGna-9UgPLYnNBSIOIHf99xqlTvnnNm_fvulx9Lrne_vqVXU_b4qnnBy9agBWAC47RJWZgPbJTRimjLBg93h3KmDiRx3k6e4uEAYOBqEBHPE-gx-xAAkoNVtpp1uY0IyEZSynCeSLJA0qOuW_t9H_Ltd85ldf24HaibR2Lu_e-H4P-M8BlgIvfKz-Pt3pD65kKD3A5_CqCrx-rryK1zFGk_iWovfa-0WdrXOklDq6dK-V6E0dIIpoQlJ_YYkACkNpGgzGxD8pDSmpsLu7PXEo-ZjOgvK0-l5-o_uui7wAAAP__5f1olA)" Some former FTX customers used social media to [voice their frustrations](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGS2yAQgOGnQR0atIuFVVCkUee0KTUYFmsTBB7A1uTtb3z11X_zzf_ntt0cJ86P3-4g22PZnO_8pg0lLBL0podgIxEQDmQnM01mWsDgsNu7mVB7ZdwEMwWDEWd0JmpNGAPiPLAFBVohLGq5zGjGWXvtzeJjgOvFKxJaUeBe6vi3cO47xfS_vKmOvhxDsnvvzybwl4BVwHqe51jp1am2TxewJnq4JGCN9dV6dZ1Llq0cJO8u_ztclrEyhSbf7DsfTZ57kXt5UpCtc4xUZaPcKXuSH6hUKOEqYB2qDc-TU-I2G6HV43Ccvk39x0NfAQAA__-Qf2iM) with the decision. Comments ranged from "laughable" and "it's a joke" to "white-collar guys get treated differently."
## Ranking America's Favorite Easter Candy
Americans are expected to spend [more than $3 billion ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuxCAQRL8GOiy8YGMKijTuLm1Ki4P13UbYWIDOub-PnDrdSDOap_d1W26eEu2PT7-ha2tefGj0wkUJsAL0onl0KyKg4uh60_emt2AUf7oRY5AIk0EFfkU_jWBhmO7DvZfKy8jJgQQtFVhph1GZbtRBB2PDGmEagkSmJUZquXTfmfb2xDW98wtLF_LGk3u2dlSmPhjMDObzPDv_Q7leLYP5-mYwS3XlicGMvjYsIvg9vsVRKGAV10iEHLIXBbFi5cXF46SUqI6GafnYPKU_XvvX_jcAAP__kpFZiQ)on Easter candy this year, with Reese's Peanut Butter Eggs or Cups being the most popular candy by sales. name: Hillsdale College via Full Mag News
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0e48477aedb44dae8240bc5e325bec19&_e=M3jBsX0U6dukKfo1FRPVZyDhGuFRyKwqmBmd4HVqzLeOB81DSbr0k0FWrYgaXJ9DJUk3jatJUnV7NRF1HbJM5rSvGULrDPm3-q7jLo5NLOqdF8UTgg2vrCs0OXxA2By5hE9k_D5qwBMIAdytbEnLqBB3-i7nWLlG9-BcOrSf7PRA3ZLQLJ_fHJpc_N7smGoMqhVhrf_UbxYvb5Dv-2BSKhgrBKwqLXv7mbNJR7VBI4sFHl21bJD1l5R_ZRHq1zVD9oFVf2Xl02RCCV1UmooYba7EubKEJFAte9UqtVi4USAK40vdXBVi8xPhk19esaY5Udq47obQ3lr63y9JFJiMWg8Kjmtds2B7QmACO4GesLiqExgK-GM87jO6oQSZmZ-SnMCn3OQ9Mw8TQyt06zw-CA%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0e48477aedb44dae8240bc5e325bec19&_e=M3jBsX0U6dukKfo1FRPVZyDhGuFRyKwqmBmd4HVqzLeOB81DSbr0k0FWrYgaXJ9DJUk3jatJUnV7NRF1HbJM5rSvGULrDPm3-q7jLo5NLOqdF8UTgg2vrCs0OXxA2By5hE9k_D5qwBMIAdytbEnLqBB3-i7nWLlG9-BcOrSf7PRA3ZLQLJ_fHJpc_N7smGoMqhVhrf_UbxYvb5Dv-2BSKhgrBKwqLXv7mbNJR7VBI4sFHl21bJD1l5R_ZRHq1zVDOAhY3-HVxwrGhq_cGPKS_-bQz6u0Me2gl_ssDKExQ3j71VTLcv7uhuk08ucjQ9nYzBF4lLkuP1sq5hjV3cK9PorTSSPiDxRKmEM3UPQwKZvAhtBWf6OlM8xo9u0w_onC7QcJxlV87inIhcCdvACA3A%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0e48477aedb44dae8240bc5e325bec19&_e=M3jBsX0U6dukKfo1FRPVZyDhGuFRyKwqmBmd4HVqzLeOB81DSbr0k0FWrYgaXJ9DJUk3jatJUnV7NRF1HbJM5rSvGULrDPm3-q7jLo5NLOqdF8UTgg2vrCs0OXxA2By5hE9k_D5qwBMIAdytbEnLqBB3-i7nWLlG9-BcOrSf7PRA3ZLQLJ_fHJpc_N7smGoMqhVhrf_UbxYvb5Dv-2BSKhgrBKwqLXv7mbNJR7VBI4sFHl21bJD1l5R_ZRHq1zVDzvAU3GZrUUs8NwtVcSjEj1WkZM_rYKhwE3Mvlf_l8UgRuKpvXhQHwjvxXlYHG9-654eWXm9bjGyQJ-fsKK7pFpeH9p8K9MZIcIqOrSDVybkMnytPhC36nlobr8AgbKG_xaubNFuzcCX02mS1qKK6hg%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: what’s happening?
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

The media can’t stop gushing about how Vice President Kamala Harris became the first Vice President in American history to visit an abortion facility.

As she spoke to the press inside a Planned Parenthood in Minnesota just recently – _the very building where innocent little boys and girls are slaughtered every day_ – the Vice President had the audacity to blast pro-life laws for being “immoral!”

To Vice President Harris and President Biden, if protecting innocent life is evil, then you and I are monsters for even daring to try.

**Pro-Life Friend, she can call us whatever names she wants, but we’re never going to stop fighting to protect innocent preborn babies!**

In fact, as you’ll see from a few of the stories below, we’ve been really busy doing just that.

Of course, everything we do depends on the generosity of good folks like you!

**[So, if you’d consider chipping in $25, $50, or even $75 to support our work, you’ll be making a massive impact](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-y/).**

The fact is, the Abortion Lobby is more emboldened than ever right now, so we have to fight back.

_Remember when they called themselves “pro-choice?”_

Well, just days ago, Planned Parenthood tweeted they want a “pro-abortion” Congress.

They want blood flowing in the streets.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-j/)
And as for President Biden, the Associated Press reported, “President Joe Biden’s campaign is betting big on abortion rights as a major driver for Democrats in the election.”

**President Biden even kicked off his State of the Union promising to impose pro-abortion legislation on the entire country!**

As William McGurn of _The Wall Street Journal_ stated in an op-ed about President Biden’s radicalism:

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-i/) _“There isn’t a single abortion he (President Biden) would restrict, and he opposes the Hyde Amendment’s limits on using tax dollars to pay for them. In political terms, there is no more absolute pro-choice stance.”_
Of course, _Students for Life Action_ made sure to crash President Biden’s State of the Union as one of our top allies in the United States House, U.S. Rep. Bob Good (R-VA) brought one of my good friends, Ryan Bomberger, as his special guest!

Ryan, as you may already know, was conceived in rape.

But thankfully, his mother chose life and placed him with a loving, adoptive family.

**And today, Ryan is a powerful pro-life Speaker.**

I know members of BOTH parties squirmed when they saw Ryan as they tried to come up with ways to politely say his life isn’t as valuable as theirs, and he shouldn’t be alive!

### **[>>> DONATE<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-d/)**

Following the _State of the Union,_ our team continued discussions with Rep. Bob Good who has helped us introduce and pass pro-life legislation, _with teeth,_ over the years – _and who might be introducing some more very soon!_

While many of his colleagues are running scared from the abortion issue, U.S. Rep. Bob Good is leading the fight!

The news from Capitol Hill just keeps coming.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-h/)
Just days ago, _Students for Life Action_ staff was out in force for U.S. Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene’s (R-GA) Congressional Hearing into continued, Black-Market Baby Organ Harvesting.

Some of the key witnesses included:

**• Terrisa Bukovinac –** a pro-life activist and one of the co-discoverers of the five late-term babies found dead at an abortion facility in Washington, D.C.; and

**• David Daleiden –** a friend of mine who became a household name with the _Center for Medical Progress_ after recording undercover videos exposing how _Planned Parenthood_ was chopping up aborted preborn babies to sell off their body parts.
_I hope you agree, we need to keep the pressure on Congress to finally blow the lid off of this sick and disgusting practice_!

### **[>>> DONATE<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-k/)**

If we don’t, we’re going to learn about more horror stories like what’s happening at the _University of Pittsburgh,_ where mad scientists at the school were caught red-handed grafting organs from recently aborted babies onto rats!

Sadly, _Students for Life Action_ has been the only national pro-life organization to hammer on this issue – insisting that Pennsylvania Republicans DEFUND the University until they quit this horrific practice.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-u/)
Just last week, our students conducted a Lobby Day to challenge actions by Republicans in Harrisburg to re-allow funding for Pitt, despite strong opposition from the pro-life movement at large.

And in the 2024 Republican primaries, we’re going to make sure voters in several races know how incumbent Republicans voted on this issue – just like we did in 2022.

After an all-out campaign by _Students for Life Action_ in 2022, three long-time, incumbent legislators were thrown out of office by voters.

Newly elected legislator Joe D’Orsie (HD-47) had this to say about our campaign:

_“I won a primary last election against a 20-year incumbent thanks to the voter education efforts of Students for Life Action knocking doors, sending mail, texts, and calls exposing the incumbent on this issue. UPitt’s experimentation with aborted-remains was an unsung issue that mattered to voters in my district. I’d like to thank SFLAction for their watchful eye of votes like these and their action when members break campaign promises and leave behind their pro-life values.”_
**Pro-Life Friend, without the generous support of good folks like you,_Students for Life Action_ wouldn’t be able to fight these battles.**

And pro-life efforts in state legislatures would have no chance.

The Abortion Lobby is stronger than us and has far more money.

So, this is a David vs. Goliath battle.

Of course, you know who won that fight though . . .

But we do depend on the generosity of good folks like you to provide the “smooth stones” we need to win the fight.

**[Even if all you can give is $10 or even $25, every dollar you can give will help tremendously](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-o/)!**

The help that you provide to _Students for Life Action_ directly impacts our ability to fight.

Thank you for everything you do for Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

[**DONATE TO _STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION_**](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-surljty-duchtdja-b/)

subject: Religious Liberty is Under Serious Threat
body:
I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6a965d11c65412eb6cac58862218bca&_e=u1FzOONVnd5MJVNYARu_VRBWAWpi32YcOo_0tOo-qUgIJoSaFdlgHzrFXehiPInH53hrYHHV8JSliOuyoc8xYEtTM9IsWIrL563seFE_YhjGTzQJ-XFXXFm8yAMG6fxr9QZjvv0vdp7CY0ovS07nA8EveSr6-COYapP2idgdXDz1cIRc2kNn5FHYXE173tbIcbz8GBiKJ7-YCjxzlNrrOiwFdlPcKDH8EQEzFuQHsWjx-HXPvLSPx7LG0ohpmXr-Dpey5c5n6lrcplppK3yK6ZSRhYYEi5ePLl8R-ntj-xApSk2Y0gvQ5katTNmLtA0qUPraNlz9nCmazSe7UUtLON42vqn_JKSNtv1YuNmESC8Uu2ujNEeI1y-1WO4i7IuKBXzKG44Au3qjdtwCX8GEeA%3D%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6a965d11c65412eb6cac58862218bca&_e=u1FzOONVnd5MJVNYARu_VRBWAWpi32YcOo_0tOo-qUgIJoSaFdlgHzrFXehiPInH53hrYHHV8JSliOuyoc8xYEtTM9IsWIrL563seFE_YhjGTzQJ-XFXXFm8yAMG6fxr9QZjvv0vdp7CY0ovS07nA8EveSr6-COYapP2idgdXDz1cIRc2kNn5FHYXE173tbIcbz8GBiKJ7-YCjxzlNrrOiwFdlPcKDH8EQEzFuQHsWjx-HXPvLSPx7LG0ohpmXr-GWjvXYBW-EMUYX3Q8lfji8w39fn_HNSX72lFaNz9_mkVd-JCvEFd39r4Ud6x02clKfsCPToWmn0ZYVpYSBMX0gSqzcHx5EoFX8hEkifQJNrWKypuItkwUsfO5MUuvTcSy0fj1_GabIiIeC9PPZHZFA%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6a965d11c65412eb6cac58862218bca&_e=u1FzOONVnd5MJVNYARu_VRBWAWpi32YcOo_0tOo-qUgIJoSaFdlgHzrFXehiPInH53hrYHHV8JSliOuyoc8xYEtTM9IsWIrL563seFE_YhjGTzQJ-XFXXFm8yAMG6fxr9QZjvv0vdp7CY0ovS07nA8EveSr6-COYapP2idgdXDz1cIRc2kNn5FHYXE173tbIcbz8GBiKJ7-YCjxzlNrrOiwFdlPcKDH8EQEzFuQHsWjx-HXPvLSPx7LG0ohpmXr-uUH02irw3wZcV9Kje3eZXZI8567DrbehEmDR_X9PaS766-DLWeNGxRXTzxqsxDq9Wa8NuH0pGhTfgwjkxtz03HngFMwj2HBjWolqvD7ho8dZBUMzWsZ7Jl8O4m1qc21QCRYUoYlYQwG1XQbfYSQo2g%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
