clean_body: I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a National Referendum on Religious Liberty. The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country... Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open. Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation. The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism." Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty. By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the National Referendum on Religious Liberty by using the secure link below: Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty." Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. The first step is ...EDUCATION. Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Save Religious Liberty in America. These efforts include: Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country. Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon. Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty. Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the National Referendum on Religious Liberty and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies. I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the National Referendum on Religious Liberty , which you can access at this secure link: Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 | | Freedom Nation Today PO Box 2221 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN HAS 10 DAYS LEFT TO ACT
UPDATE 3/29/24
MON, APRIL 8 DEADLINE
GENERAL ASSEMBLY RECONVENES WED, APRIL 17
---
---
| Friends, Great news! On Tuesday, March 26, Governor Youngkin vetoed 30 bills that targeted law abiding gun owners, including measures that would have halted the sale of certain semi-automatic firearms. To date, the Governor has vetoed 32 such bills.
That said, the Governor also signed into law gun control bills HB22 and SB210 regarding auto sears, and SB44, regarding abuse and neglect of children; causing or enabling child to gain possession of a firearm, penalty. He also offered amendments to 6 gun control bills. These are all listed below and highlighted.
We need to watch these 6 bills closely when the General Assembly meets for reconvene in April.
Here is the most current list of bills Governor Youngkin has either signed into law, vetoed or amended.
Any of the 2,000 plus bills that the governor does not act on become law.
If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed.
The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on Wednesday, April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.

clean_body: The Governor has 30 Days to Act | | | | GOVERNOR YOUNGKIN HAS 10 DAYS LEFT TO ACT UPDATE 3/29/24 MON, APRIL 8 DEADLINE GENERAL ASSEMBLY RECONVENES WED, APRIL 17 | Friends, Great news! On Tuesday, March 26, Governor Youngkin vetoed 30 bills that targeted law abiding gun owners, including measures that would have halted the sale of certain semi-automatic firearms. To date, the Governor has vetoed 32 such bills. That said, the Governor also signed into law gun control bills HB22 and SB210 regarding auto sears, and SB44, regarding abuse and neglect of children; causing or enabling child to gain possession of a firearm, penalty. He also offered amendments to 6 gun control bills. These are all listed below and highlighted. We need to watch these 6 bills closely when the General Assembly meets for reconvene in April. Here is the most current list of bills Governor Youngkin has either signed into law, vetoed or amended. Any of the 2,000 plus bills that the governor does not act on become law. If you desire to get more information on one of the bills listed below just click the button below for each committee and the bill history and summary is listed. The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on Wednesday, April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes. Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar. | Please also consider following me on == for my real time daily posts regarding votes on controversial and significant impact bills. Hope you find my daily and weekly newsletter along with my Facebook posts helpful in following the General Assembly. I will continue to follow the legislation through reconvene on Wednesday, April 17. | | == | BILLS ON THE GOVERNOR'S DESK | Now that the Virginia Legislature has adjourned Sine Die as of Saturday, Governor Youngkin has 30 days, Monday, April 8, to act on over 2,200 bills that have passed the Democrat controlled Senate and House. Click the links to below to see an updated list of actions taken by the Governor. | == | | == | | == | | == | == BY GOVERNOR AS OF TODAY | BILL LIST: VETOED BY GOVERNOR == Minimum wage; increases wage to $13.50 per hour effective January 1, 2025. == Assault firearms & certain ammunition, etc.; purchase, possession, sale, transfer, etc., prohibited. == Earned sentence credits; incarceration prior to entry of final order of conviction. == Firearm; transfers to another person from a prohibited person. == Criminal cases; request for a jury to ascertain punishment. == Robbery; conforms certain provisions of the Code of VA to the degrees of robbery offenses, etc. == Surrogacy brokers; repeals statute of prohibition. == Minimum wage; My wife and I, now, write and produce Patch the Pirate, one of the largest syndicated religious children's broadcasts in the world. The goal is to introduce kids and families to Jesus. Six years ago, I ran for the SC House of Reps and won by knocking on 4,000 doors. I founded the South Carolina Freedom Caucus with fellow conservative lawmakers and served as Chairman. _**Last year, our Freedom Caucus members were kicked out of the SC House GOP caucus for refusing to sign a loyalty pledge to never campaign against other "Republicans" or to share pics of the public voting board with voters.**_ Since then, dark money groups tied to uniparty leadership and special interests have spent over $1 million in attack ads against all of us in the South Carolina Freedom Caucus. It's time for me to represent YOU in Washington DC. I reject the idea that America is doomed. My kid's futures are on the line. name: Dovid Efune
subject: American journalism is back
body:
As we mark this year the second anniversary of The New York Sun's return to national daily publishing, reports on our industry are dire.
Join the Sun and restore American journalism.

| | | [](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=e965d56f1d0e45e69e537a68b3ede010&_e=3a0yuUhKTZFhYo-fVzPfkchhOyXUk-x1kEE2VZhoPoc4WBFhdcrSe_cKSM7EJxP2WOCqhy4czm2yB3GYoZcIfpQqaoGtnCYdUkKZhZhYo9KjgLIkeWOJr6jxNCOZbVlUNrrX7G5Vgl2_rJ8HPHcwzUxZu5fBxz86PyB5SELI73M7fZ5HvRSgu7vPXKPTr1zF2tyRJVKzj4wLwdwxmu2zGtSiBMXJk0t3YfW9xruON9lxMse7HFZ5Q68GBmuLPg29GCKXiOsLNcdevmQYnVJRvDuigWgzgqaE-t3fyoB0csmawN3CO1Mtkhopj7-A2mksy_0lcvXOBfw2RMmx8AKIxHmbokaSJ5lPCQRuomiRflwa-lw0lD6-7sXRiQ0FSbIk)

| | _Dear Reader,_ _It's no secret that the mainstream press is failing the American people dismally. And yet, I'm optimistic about the future. Americans are waking up, and the movement to save American journalism is gathering speed._ _It is the honor of my life to help lead the charge by returning the famed New York Sun to the center of the national conversation. Below is a note I just shared with my fellow citizens on the recent anniversary of our return to publication. I hope you'll take a moment to read it and consider joining our fast growing movement._ _We need you. We need every patriot to stand with us._ *** As we mark this year the second anniversary of The New York Sun's return to national daily publishing, reports on our industry are dire. Layoffs are everywhere. Last month, Los Angeles Times fired 20 percent of its newsroom. The Wall Street Journal reduced the staff of its Washington bureau. NBC News, ABC News, Time magazine, Sports Illustrated, National Geographic, Insider, NPR, Vox, Conde Nast, and CBC all announced layoffs. Buzzfeed News, Pitchfork, and the Messenger shuttered their doors completely. A Northwestern University study released in November finds that nationally, newspapers are closing down at a rate of 2.5 a week, mostly weekly publications issued locally. Questions swirl about the future of the industry. One headline in the Atlantic asks, "Is American Journalism Headed Toward an Extinction-Level Event?" Predictions are dire. Uncertainty is rampant. The mood, in general, is grim.
---
| | [JOIN THE SUN](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=e965d56f1d0e45e69e537a68b3ede010&_e=3a0yuUhKTZFhYo-fVzPfkchhOyXUk-x1kEE2VZhoPoc4WBFhdcrSe_cKSM7EJxP2WOCqhy4czm2yB3GYoZcIfpQqaoGtnCYdUkKZhZhYo9KjgLIkeWOJr6jxNCOZbVlUNrrX7G5Vgl2_rJ8HPHcwzUxZu5fBxz86PyB5SELI73M7fZ5HvRSgu7vPXKPTr1zF2tyRJVKzj4wLwdwxmu2zGtSiBMXJk0t3YfW9xruON9khkchj4hi6kWBufI_ZkVP3ov35O816iYZ8mmpVPJEMfcD4k11FY0dUNNmWGlDcPRZfgNWyrwkcdGGvCUGTKuKkYQTiQStE16jb9Xif2ks9TnPJCbCl46LuT7zz10nr_klGhHzXxot8DzAEt4VKKupm)
---
| | It would be a mistake, though, to ignore the fact that human nature is a constant. The uniform desire - nay, need - to be informed has obtained since the birth of civilization. “The newspaper is an article of primary necessity," the Sun's pioneering 19th century editor, Charles Dana, once said. "You must have your breakfast, but you must have your newspaper too." Indeed, news consumption on the whole remains high. It seems, then, that what appears as a contraction is in fact a form of correction. The market is offering a vigorous reminder of its most enduring truth, that a newspaper's primary customer is its reader. It's a principle that in many quarters has faded over time, more so amid the industry upheaval that has in recent decades accompanied the digital revolution. This and other factors have led to a realignment of priorities at many of our country's most storied publishers. They have come to serve other masters. First among them are advertisers. The temptation is understandable. They've long paid the newsman's bills. The Sun, we must confess, played a role in introducing this model. As the first penny daily, it sold for a fraction of the price of competitor papers. It pioneered front-page advertising to offset the lower subscription price. Later, Charles Dana was described as being "barely tolerant" of advertisers and dreamed of a newspaper that was wholly supported by readers.Other papers have come to prioritize the politics, leading to a deliberate effort to downplay important stories of public interest. There have been newspapers acquired as status symbols by billionaires and deployed as ideological playthings. Others have been designed or repurposed as government organs. The Telegraph in Britain, a fine newspaper, is now at risk of being swallowed up by the United Arab Emirates. There are even calls for government funding of newspapers and journalism en masse, a terrible idea, and fully incompatible with the democratic vision of a free press. At the Sun, we hold the view that the opportunity remains greater than ever for any newspaper that is compiled with a view to serve the reader above all. In the words of Charles Dana, a newspaper "must correspond to the wants of the people. It must furnish that sort of information which the people demand, or else it can never be successful." Our aim is for every interaction with the Sun to inform, educate, inspire, and uplift our readers. To do battle on their behalf to protect the "social freedom" that our republic is in danger of entirely losing. So that "every intellectual plant grows vigorously and bears its fruit without hindrance from any quarter." We’ve been encouraged by the public reception so far. I'm pleased to report that our readership has grown by more than 300 percent over the past year. Paying memberships, sustaining the Sun's journalism, have grown by 500 percent. We've added new, exciting talent to our newsroom. Daily we hear from young people who are hopeful about making a career of journalism. We're not guided by the subjective and parochial analysis of what might be decreed "fit to print." We're a paper that for nearly 200 years has borne the promise to "shine for all." That means relentlessly seeking the benefit and welfare of our readers and all of the public which we serve. Nothing less will do for the Sun. So may I take this occasion to express, on behalf of my colleagues as well as myself, my sincerest thanks to each of you who have joined us over the past year. And to declare that our arms are held open to all Americans who have yet to make the Sun their home.

name: Team Daniels
subject: FW: Our Most Important Deadline!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Daniels For Congress
body:
Dear Friend,
We just wanted to make sure you saw Shamaine’s email about our incredibly important March 31st fundraising deadline. We’ve set an ambitious goal that will allow us to continue our voter engagement efforts and GOTV programs through the April primary.
We’ll be honest, we’re not meeting our goal right now and without your help, we won’t be able to reach the voters we need to put Shamaine over the top.
In 2022, when no one was willing to take on Scott Perry, Shamaine stepped up. She’s counting on you to step up this time around so she can finish the job!
Can you chip in to help us fill our fundraising gap with a contribution of $100, $50, or whatever you can afford? Click here to donate before the deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thank you for all that you do,
Team Daniels
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Begin Forwarded Message
Date: March 28, 2024
From Shamaine Daniels <Shamaine@danielsforcongress.org>
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
March 31st will be the biggest test of our campaign to unseat Scott Perry. It’s an important fundraising deadline and the last one before the April 23rd primary election. I wanted to take a moment and lay out to you why I’m the best candidate to beat Scott Perry. That message is below. If you already support my campaign, I am asking for your help one more time to help us reach the most important goal in this campaign so far. Click here to contribute [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
The stakes in this election couldn’t be higher. Democrats are only a few seats away from control of the U.S. House of Representatives and this seat could be THE deciding race. With everything on the line, I’m asking the voters in PA-10 to remember the work we’ve already done. I’m proud of the race my team and I ran in 2022. We outperformed in a district that was redrawn to be more Republican by the courts. We achieved this with minimal funding and no national democratic support.
As you know, this district is now targeted, which means the nominee will receive support and resources from the national party. If I am the nominee, I’ll be able to build on all of the hard work we did in 2022 and finish the job. I’m the candidate the voters in this district know and trust.
To be successful, I need your help and I’m asking you to support my campaign with a contribution today. Please dig deep and contribute what you can to help us reach our March 31st fundraising goal here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
The nominee we choose in PA-10 matters . Voters have a choice and I am the strongest nominee to take on Scott Perry in November. Voters in this district know me and I have a record of standing up for the values that will be front and center in this election. Along with being a longtime Democrat, I’m a proud pro-choice woman who has spent my career fighting for women’s rights. My work on these issues was recognized by the National Organization for Women when they endorsed my candidacy.
Comprehensive immigration reform is long overdue, and our economy needs it now more than ever. As an immigration attorney and Venezuelan-American, I have seen the results of our broken system up close. As a City Councilwoman, I’ve seen our family farms close and our businesses struggle with the lack of available labor. As a longtime Harrisburg resident, I know how medically underserved we are and what a functioning visa program would mean for bringing specialty doctors, home care workers, and childcare workers into our community.
We have all have witnessed Scott Perry and his allies in Congress block the bipartisan immigration reform bill that could have addressed many of these issues while implementing stringent border security measures. If elected to Congress, I would prioritize fixing our broken immigration system - not playing politics with such an important issue. I am honored that my efforts on these issues were acknowledged through endorsements from CASA in Action, Second Generation, and the Latino Victory Fund. With the support of these organizations, we will be well-positioned to engage and mobilize voters in our district who may not always participate in elections but are concerned about these issues.
Even with the help from these groups and the attention of national Democrats, our campaign will need the resources to get our message out to the voters of PA-10. That is why we’ve set an aggressive March 31st fundraising goal and I’m asking you for your support.
Click here to join our campaign and make a contribution of $100, $50, $25, or whatever you can afford before the March 31st deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With gratitude,
Shamaine
DONATE NOW! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]

Daniels For Congress
2018 North 3rd Street
Harrisburg, PA 17102
United States

subject: Cowards

body:
I’m writing to you because Kari Lake was recently endorsed by Josh Hawley, the Senator from Missouri.
#

Peter, this is retired Capitol Police Staff Sergeant and U.S. Army Veteran Aquilino Gonell.
I’m writing to you because Kari Lake was recently endorsed by Josh Hawley, the Senator from Missouri.
Yes, this Josh Hawley:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar24.sAuZhx&refcode=em240329-1-160&t=1&akid=2140%2E734936%2Eg04MAV)

Friend, I’m the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran. I was taught the values of hard work, determination, and persistence from a young age.
I carried these values with me when I was working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace to help pay for college and, later, when I was a computer programmer in a male-dominated field. Today, I carry these values with me as I work in the U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81889145/463828525/1553268835?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3649-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmYxMDZjMS1jZmVkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6GDdKXIVIBB-Kq0WRP8cTNRUb-NBCR_AWxfSQ_WIYq0=)

As the most vulnerable Democratic woman in the Senate, the GOP has made me a top target for defeat – in the race that experts predict could decide Senate control. Now, dark-money groups like the Koch network are pouring money into Nevada to flip it red, and I can't fight back without your immediate grassroots support.

Hey teammate, it's Graham from the Ehasz Finance Team here. You're going to hear a LOT about our upcoming deadline over the next few days. But this isn't just any old end-of-month deadline. **March 31st is...**
* Our first FEC deadline of 2024 – that's when we have to file our finance reports on how much we've raised and spent, and then those are made public
* Our first end-of-quarter deadline of 2024

body:
Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew, not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81891923/463836508/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjY0YzhkNi1kMWVkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E6ecuLN2mc_rG4qNargYpXiTsi5glj86GuMfFeb6Qxk=&emci=9bd93207-1ded-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=9264c8d6-d1ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=26261389)
---

| | Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew, not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later. When I donated it to the Smithsonian, the knees were dusted with dirt from the night I spent cleaning trash off of the Capitol's rotunda floor on January 6. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81891925/463836517/-1197072038?refcode=2024-03-29-bluesuit&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=9264c8d6-d1ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjY0YzhkNi1kMWVkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E6ecuLN2mc_rG4qNargYpXiTsi5glj86GuMfFeb6Qxk=) Honestly, I had seriously considered throwing the suit away until the Smithsonian called. That day still brings such terrible memories for me; I knew I'd never wear it again. **But the story of January 6 isn't just about violence, insurrection, and trauma.** Like our country's story, that day ended full of hope, resilience, civility, and service. Even the simple step I took to help clean up that trash the insurrectionists left behind sparked something much more significant. In the weeks that followed, I received thousands of cards and letters from folks across the country who were inspired or comforted by what they saw. I still cherish every single one. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81891926/463836524/-1197072038?refcode=2024-03-29-bluesuit&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=9264c8d6-d1ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjY0YzhkNi1kMWVkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E6ecuLN2mc_rG4qNargYpXiTsi5glj86GuMfFeb6Qxk=) Those cards remind me how strong this country is, and how strong we can be when we come together. Right now, our partisan divide can seem so deep that it threatens to tear us apart. We saw it on full display on January 6, and we must ensure nothing like that ever happens again. That means working with Congress to protect our Capitol, but it also means all of us working together to find common ground. **That common ground is closer than you might realize.** I can clearly see the disconnect between the partisan wars being waged in D.C., the in-fighting within the GOP's own party, and the priorities of my friends and neighbors in New Jersey. We are honestly all just exhausted by the endless cycles of misinformation and outrage. It's a mess, for sure – and it's all of ours to clean up together. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81891927/463836526/-1197072038?refcode=2024-03-29-bluesuit&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=9264c8d6-d1ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjY0YzhkNi1kMWVkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E6ecuLN2mc_rG4qNargYpXiTsi5glj86GuMfFeb6Qxk=) I'm raising my two Jersey boys in the same community that welcomed my parents from South Korea. Everything I have done in Congress is to keep the promise I made to help build them a better world than the one we inherited — **and now, I am running for U.S. Senate to bring that same integrity and an emphasis on putting people first.** That's why the movement we're building is focused on civility and service, starting in the same New Jersey community that raised me and stretching out to every corner of our country. clean_body: Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew, not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later. | | | | Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew, not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later. When I donated it to the Smithsonian, the knees were dusted with dirt from the night I spent cleaning trash off of the Capitol's rotunda floor on January 6. = Honestly, I had seriously considered throwing the suit away until the Smithsonian called. That day still brings such terrible memories for me; I knew I'd never wear it again. But the story of January 6 isn't just about violence, insurrection, and trauma. Like our country's story, that day ended full of hope, resilience, civility, and service. Even the simple step I took to help clean up that trash the insurrectionists left behind sparked something much more significant. In the weeks that followed, I received thousands of cards and letters from folks across the country who were inspired or comforted by what they saw. I still cherish every single one. = Those cards remind me how strong this country is, and how strong we can be when we come together. Right now, our partisan divide can seem so deep that it threatens to tear us apart. We saw it on full display on January 6, and we must ensure nothing like that ever happens again. That means working with Congress to protect our Capitol, but it also means all of us working together to find common ground. That common ground is closer than you might realize. I can clearly see the disconnect between the partisan wars being waged in D.C., the in-fighting within the GOP's own party, and the priorities of my friends and neighbors in New Jersey. We are honestly all just exhausted by the endless cycles of misinformation and outrage. It's a mess, for sure – and it's all of ours to clean up together. = I'm raising my two Jersey boys in the same community that welcomed my parents from South Korea. Everything I have done in Congress is to keep the promise I made to help build them a better world than the one we inherited — and now, I am running for U.S. Senate to bring that same integrity and an emphasis on putting people first. That's why the movement we're building is focused on civility and service, starting in the same New Jersey community that raised me and stretching out to every corner of our country. = = More soon, Andy | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | Paid for by Andy Kim for New Jersey | This email was sent by . name: John Pierce
subject: J6: Help Save this Grandmother from 3 years in prison!
body:
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfvfjbm1e3rircqctkfn77bl825n4i15ssthb4o0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctj6cob1cph2bs)

Rebecca drove 25 hours across our nation to attend the January 6th Rally in 2021. Three years later, she faces three years in federal prison and fines of up to $200,000. Why? [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbo3p25ncsbtd56vc0mme957tc5969hkb7fi2f88_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctj6cob1cph2bs) Dear Patriot,

Rebecca Lavrenz is a registered nurse and mother proud of her six grandchildren and one great-grandson.

She is a patriot who loves her country and will fight for it peacefully.

Rebecca drove 25 hours across our nation to attend the January 6th Rally in 2021.

Three years later, she faces three years in federal prison and fines of up to $200,000.

Why? She walked into the Nation's Capital for 10 minutes. She followed a crowd who stepped in without police telling them to stop. She said nothing while in the building and damaged nothing. She prayed to "bring God inside the Capitol" with her presence and prayers.

My name is John Pierce, and I represent Rebecca and over 30 other January 6th defendants **[who need your help](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7ah0mnc5uj3a3iluliv8g3bll9n39qmjqrthni0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctj6cob1cph2bs).**

My organization, the National Constitutional Law Union, has been fighting for these Americans on shoestring budgets for years while facing the unstoppable Goliath, the Department of Justice.

Biden's DOJ is making us fight every step of the way. They refuse to produce discovery and the 302s of the FBI's interviews related to Rebecca's case. A 302 is a form used by the FBI to summarize an interview, and since they don't record interviews to protect themselves, the 302 is a key piece of evidence needed to vindicate my client.

And the DOJ and FBI do this regularly, requiring me to ask a judge to compel them to produce evidence that should have been handed over before trial.

Why do they do this?

To wear me out. The more filings and hearings needed to defend these Americans add to the expense and time. We have limited resources, and as you know, our Department of Justice has no limit to what it's willing to spend to imprison any American who stepped foot on Capital grounds on January 6th.

Rebecca Lavrenz did no harm and is a victim of Biden's zealous mission to send one message to the American people. That message is this: "NEVER stand up to your government!"

But their message is falling on deaf ears, and **[I need your help to send a message right back to them](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv343ksejanrh3ebd1qdf7bibcspuug48kq84168_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctj6cob1cph2bs)** by saving this Christian grandmother from federal prison.

**[Will you chip in today to help cover our costs in defending Rebecca and over 30 other patriots?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9bv3bhj7a125as98h81lit183p5rl1b4adjmue8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctj6cob1cph2bs)**

Rebecca's trial is right around the corner, and I need to cover airline travel for myself and my staff along with hotel rooms for weeks--as long as it takes.

**[Any amount you can donate is greatly appreciated.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc47ifql4n7tfgq5vnn0bpvss3t66ahc76hkpffo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctj6cob1cph2bs)**

**[Please donate whatever you can afford and pray for Rebecca and her family as the trial nears.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd4pa3o83j460p9jk9dt8fcnp8lbrp991ignmbv0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34ctj6cob1cph2bs)

** In Vigilance,

John M. Pierce
Chairman and Founder
National Constitutional Law Union

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Happy Easter Weekend! ✝️ 🐣 🐰_**
---
Friends, As we begin this holiday weekend today with Good Friday and concluding with Easter Sunday, we want to take a moment to express our heartfelt appreciation to each and every one of you. The hard work, and commitment each of you has contributed throughout the year is the only reason we are able to build our party from the grassroots-up, and for that we are deeply grateful. THANK YOU! In the midst of our active schedules and our dedication to our common goals, let us not overlook the importance of rest, rejuvenation, and spending quality time with loved ones that this holy weekend provides. Make sure to enjoy this time with your family and friends, then return with renewed energy and focus as we head deeper into this all important election year. Thank you for your continued dedication and commitment to electing strong Republican leadership across the state of Indiana. Together, let us embrace the spirit of Easter and Good Friday as we move forward with optimism and resolve. Thank you for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# 📚 Hoosier Republicans Leading on Education 🎓
---
Hoosiers are humble, but some accomplishments deserve proper recognition. It is time that we spread the word about the great work that our Hoosier Republican leaders have done to fund Indiana’s education system statewide. Over the last 10+ years, Republican leadership has made HISTORIC investments in our state’s education system:
* Historic increases in funding for K-12 and higher education.
* Paying down $600 million in teacher pension debt.
* Exceeding the recommendations of the Teacher Pay Commission.
* Increasing the average teacher salary every year, including a $7,000 increase between 2018 and 2023.
* Increasing the MINIMUM teacher salary to $40,000.
* $1.47 BILLION more for K-12 education in 2023 alone.
* Fully funded textbook costs so that parents aren’t burdened with these expenses.
* Auto enrollment in the 21st Century Scholars Program, so no kid misses out on the opportunity they didn’t know they had.
* Near universal school choice expansion, so that every parent can send their child to the school that best serves their needs.

Hoosier Republicans have dedicated 56.6% of Indiana's budget to education. These investments show that Hoosier Republicans consider education a top priority and are putting forth the resources necessary to provide a top-notch education for all children in Indiana.

Friend --
Let's take a moment to talk about these FEC fundraising deadlines and the emails that are probably severely clogging your inbox about them.
First, this deadline on March 31st actually is a real deadline. And when it ends, we're legally required to report not just how much money we've raised, but how much of it comes from large donations vs. smaller donations.
Those reports are also made public and I can tell you from experience that a lot of people are looking at them. The press looks, our opponents look, potential outside spending operations look...
They want to see the strength of our campaign financially. They want to see if we have small-dollar grassroots support that is sustainable in a way large donations are not. And critically, some of the big-money super PACs want to see if we're vulnerable to an attack we can't afford to respond to.

subject: This seems familiar…

| Peter,

**Republicans know they have a problem with young voters.** It’s why they’ve spent so much time and effort trying to stop us from voting, whether it’s through restrictive voting laws designed to stop college students from casting ballots or their outrageous proposals to raise the voting age.

But they’re starting to wake up to the fact that whether they like it or not, young people _will_ vote if they’re motivated to turn out.

**So the GOP is changing tactics.** ALEC Action — the campaign arm of the American Legislative Exchange Council, which pushes for the passage of ultra-right-wing bills in state legislatures across the country — is teaming up with Run GenZ to boost young “conservatives” who are running for office.

**Seem like a familiar strategy?_We thought so too._****[Will you split $10 or any amount you can between Leaders We Deserve and Democrats Win Seats? Every donation helps us double down on our strategy to elect progressive young leaders instead. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81898289/463851618/-1896636304?amount=10&source=NBI_DWSPAC_20240329_FR_EOQ_0_1MO_davidhogg_NA_NA_1.4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODBjMjk5My1kN2VkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k9wncPsqcdmwrJw_PLAcUWS3Sq3ta5wM-86ysGgS5L8=)**

But let’s be real for a second. The fact that the Republican party is nearly entirely dominated by old, out-of-touch white dudes isn’t the real source of their problem with young voters (though it certainly doesn’t help).

**Republicans have a young voter problem because of their platform.** Young people today have grown up amidst near-constant mass shootings across the country, including in our schools. We see the evidence of a changing climate before our very eyes, and we know the impact it could have on our future.

But despite all this, Republicans have consistently fought to make it _easier_ to access **dangerous guns** and stood in the way of common-sense gun safety laws that could keep young people safe in school. And they continue to deny the reality of **climate change** in the face of overwhelming evidence.

Plus, while young people today are more pro-choice and pro-equality than ever, Republicans across the country have made it their mission to chip away at **LGBTQ+ rights** and pass draconian **abortion bans** , often with no exceptions whatsoever.

So MAGA is welcome to put a fresh young face on their horrible old policies — but that won’t change the fact that young voters are overwhelmingly opposed to their agenda.

**In contrast, Leaders We Deserve is working to elect young leaders who will fight _for_ young people’s priorities, not against them. But we’re a grassroots organization that takes no corporate funding, so we’re counting on your support to do it.**

**[If you want to expose the GOP's latest astroturfed effort to target young people as the sham it is, split $10 or anything you can right now to help us elect the leaders we really deserve on Election Day.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81898290/463851619/-1896636304?amount=10&source=NBI_DWSPAC_20240329_FR_EOQ_0_1MO_davidhogg_NA_NA_1.4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODBjMjk5My1kN2VkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k9wncPsqcdmwrJw_PLAcUWS3Sq3ta5wM-86ysGgS5L8=)**

Thanks for your support,

David Hogg

| WEEKLY NEWSLETTERMarch 29th, 2024
---
|
---
| | **A Note from CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)** Last week, ISIS carried out a devastating terrorist attack in Moscow, killing over 100 innocent civilians in the worst terrorist attack Russia has seen in decades. This month, a member of Hezbollah was detained on our own border, planning to attack our homeland. The instability in the Middle East caused by Joe Biden and his open border policies are a huge threat to our national security, but our leaders in Washington do not take it with the seriousness it demands. **Rest assured, when I am elected to the US Senate, I will.** The news may be grim, but I remain hopeful thanks to the support of patriots across the Commonwealth. Last week, we submitted over 17,000 signatures to be on the U.S. Senate ballot in Virginia, which takes us one step closer towards taking back our country! We must continue to build on this momentum to ensure a better future for America. I hope you and your families have a blessed Good Friday and Easter! \- CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)

| | ****Easter Blessings ✝️****
---
| |
---
As we kick off Easter weekend, I'd like to share a cherished memory I reflect on around this same time every year. When I was a young boy, my dad and I got stuck behind a bus spouting thick, black smoke from its engine. I noticed that he started to reminisce, saying it reminded him of April 1, 1945—the [best Easter Sunday](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=e0da21ad2b4a4205be870b447b261b45&_e=xD57ASVWL7QtJ2YThOozTbrtEXz3jeDwtZXLDuYJoCcq-SFaCTWwBChgzkQ7guoeeMrfThCxAKif2SRO-4r93y0CSv_zTYw8qJQdFRkb-fasHCu7imoan1dXKeWVijlhB3DoLCdYaqUBWVPhf48Qr6K87GMl3LoJa58fK0m3nUIZRPOzpNybKw4b3a-wLsb2jMtpVjkiXv0F6HaaBtKDoXVhgLrgl6ggsejHsZuVKZR-noX5KXQmMSvcurxIh3jR) he ever had. On that day, amid the tumult of war, my dad and his fellow U.S. Marines landed on the heavily guarded shores of Okinawa, Japan. The fighting was tough, but this would turn out to be the last major clash of World War II, a momentous victory for the Allied forces. All the blood, smoke, and strife made my father a resilient and patriotic man. He carried those lessons of war throughout his life, inspiring others with his unwavering dedication to service and country. Though my dad is no longer with us, I reflect on this story every Easter weekend. It prompts me to pause and remember the countless men and women who have given their lives so we can live freely. As we gather with loved ones this weekend, let’s all spare a moment to pray for our service members spending this Easter Sunday far from home in the name of freedom. There’s no doubt that we are forever indebted to them for the sacrifices they make to protect our nation. I wish you all a blessed Easter with the people you love.

I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL.
But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family.
**I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation.**
_Now, I’m ready for my next challenge:_ firing Ted Cruz and being the voice all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in 2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it done, Peter.
[**That’s why I’m asking you to chip in right now to become a General Election Founding Donor and help reach our ambitious $1 million goal. We need an unprecedented grassroots movement to unseat Ted Cruz, and I’m counting on you to be a part of it. Colin Allred

In my investigation of the flow of migrants through the Darien Gap, I came across the San Vicente Migrant Camp that was overflowing with Chinese and Islamic migrants headed to the United States to illegally cross our borders. | | | | [](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FbBNRcopN9rbvnP4rng8763UA%2FpJy892763Jfv26b6nXNJYTHtZg/1/0100018e8ab7a5b2-b4f4733a-3d51-4d8c-b02f-71233c2d873b-000000/Ox6QAajZUDb1jLYlezf41QAWE7I=367) | [](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FbBNRcopN9rbvnP4rng8763UA%2FpJy892763Jfv26b6nXNJYTHtZg/2/0100018e8ab7a5b2-b4f4733a-3d51-4d8c-b02f-71233c2d873b-000000/D9GWlg8Mz0igLTiTX3Pz5ryaMcc=367)
Dear Friend,

In my investigation of the flow of migrants through the Darien Gap, I came across the San Vicente Migrant Camp that was overflowing with Chinese and Islamic migrants headed to the United States to illegally cross our borders.

These camps don't just pop up organically. They are staffed and directed by non-governmental organizations (NGOs) worldwide. One of those groups and the leading player at the San Vicente Camp is an NGO called HIAS, which stands for Hebrew Immigrant Aid Society.

Last week, I exposed HIAS's assistance to the thousands of Chinese and Islamic migrants headed to our nation, and guess what happened next?

A supposed riot broke out at the camp, and the office that houses the records of the migrants crossing into Panama was burned to the ground.

Any trace of these invaders' origins and the assistance provided by HIAS is now literally up in smoke.

But, my investigation continues, and **[your help is needed to keep going](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FTepjnIdkKHQDrtX4lokjFw%2FpJy892763Jfv26b6nXNJYTHtZg/1/0100018e8ab7a5b2-b4f4733a-3d51-4d8c-b02f-71233c2d873b-000000/WRQTDzr7GSG2e_xnfpKYAimaREs=367).**

I still have hundreds of hours of footage to edit and release, along with follow-up interviews to conduct, and I am turning all of my footage into a documentary about the invasion of our country... but the cost is becoming overwhelming.

The web of money funding these NGOs is astounding . . . we're talking billions of dollars being spent to funnel foreign bodies into America every single year.

And much of it is coming from our own government, as I have exposed, and plan on continuing to expose.

**[Help me expose it all and stop the flow of cash that enables our nation to be invaded by criminal illegal aliens each day.](https://5gcvd67r.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flibersend.loomered.com%2Fl%2FbZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA%2FTepjnIdkKHQDrtX4lokjFw%2FpJy892763Jfv26b6nXNJYTHtZg/2/0100018e8ab7a5b2-b4f4733a-3d51-4d8c-b02f-71233c2d873b-000000/lp04hD0binrIti2xSG3g3sd4isc=367)**

Any amount you can contribute is greatly appreciated.

Thanks again for all that you do.

Respectfully,

Laura Loomer

name: Medhini Kumar, Evergreen
subject: BREAKING: Major cuts to climate pollution
body:
Biden's biggest transportation month ever
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2434527/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2434528/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Hi Friend,

March was transportation month in the Biden administration.

Transportation is responsible for more climate pollution than any other sector in the U.S., but in recent months advocates like you showed up in a big way—thanks in part to the collective comments and actions of the movement, **we have three huge wins to celebrate this month:** |
---
|
1. First, the Biden administration announced the **biggest-ever coordinated federal investment to electrify our freight industry.** This will translate to hundreds of thousands of jobs, less pollution, and more clean trucks on the road.
2. Last week, the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) set the **strongest-ever pollution standards for light-duty vehicles.** This rule sets the stage for most cars, SUVs, and small trucks sold in the U.S. to be all-electric or hybrids by 2032.
3. Today, **EPA finalized its "Phase 3" rule for heavy-duty vehicles** , which will help electrify America’s trucking fleet, buses, and trains, avoid a billion tons worth of greenhouse gas pollution, and bring cleaner air to the 72 million Americans living near trucking routes.

Transportation is responsible for more climate pollution than any other sector in the U.S., but in recent months advocates like you showed up in a big way—thanks in part to the collective comments and actions of the movement, we have three huge wins to celebrate this month: | | 1. First, the Biden administration announced the biggest-ever coordinated federal investment to electrify our freight industry. This will translate to hundreds of thousands of jobs, less pollution, and more clean trucks on the road. 2. Last week, the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) set the strongest-ever pollution standards for light-duty vehicles. This rule sets the stage for most cars, SUVs, and small trucks sold in the U.S. to be all-electric or hybrids by 2032. 3. Today, EPA finalized its "Phase 3" rule for heavy-duty vehicles , which will help electrify America’s trucking fleet, buses, and trains, avoid a billion tons worth of greenhouse gas pollution, and bring cleaner air to the 72 million Americans living near trucking routes. | | Together, these rules will dramatically cut climate pollution and clean up some of the most toxic air in the country—largely in Black, Brown, and low-income communities. Recently, we announced a major component of our 2024 strategy to get more women elected in states with abortion bans: The launch of **_Her Bold Move – Texas!_**

Thanks to Greg Abbott, Ken Paxton, and their majority-male state legislature, **abortion is completely banned in Texas.** We won’t stand by quietly as the women of Texas continue to get left behind. We are fighting back by chipping away at the male majorities in the Texas government – and replacing those anti-choice men in office with women.

subject: The first time we’re doing this since a Republican opponent got in the race against me:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
Campaigns are chock-full of surprises, but you can count on some events like clockwork.
Campaigns are chock-full of surprises, but you can count on some events like clockwork. And one of them’s coming up fast.
In just a few days, we’ll file an official report with the FEC on our fundraising for the last three months.
The numbers will be public.
The thing that makes this report so important — and different from all of our previous reports — is that this will be the first time we share our fundraising performance since a Republican opponent entered this race against me.
Our opponent, his GOP supporters, special interests, Big Tech moguls, Wall Street executives, and far-right ideologues will scour our numbers for any signs of weakness.
Not just because they want to defeat me for re-election — but also because they want to prove that there isn’t enough momentum for our progressive agenda. And if Republicans win more support and gain more power, they’d have more ability to pass their far-right agenda and block progress on the plans this movement is fighting for.
I am fighting with everything I’ve got to defeat their extremism and put power into the hands of working people.
But I can’t do it alone. A whole bunch of $5 donations add up fast to demonstrate widespread support for ending Washington corruption, ensuring the right to an abortion, guaranteeing universal child care, getting the wealthy to pay their fair share, tackling corporate price gouging, and making Washington work for working families.
[**So, we've got to show our opponents that there’s a big, tough team fighting for this re-election campaign and this mission. And one of the best ways to do that is by making a donation before our March 31 deadline. Peter, my story starts with my mom. She raised me on her own, sometimes working two jobs to make ends meet. As a public school teacher, she taught me to value education; although I excelled in sports, homework always came first in our house.

A lot of the policies I'm fighting for now – affordable child care, universal pre-k, more support and opportunities for our kids – are informed by the tough choices I watched her make while I was growing up.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81913378/463894771/1744507883?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk367-fr-welcome&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzcxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjU4N2FjYi1lNWVkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c1c7xz6U08ok5Mw0eGpVV_65UpR9xN9kgFzVJ1BDGAE=)
My world was small growing up. I don't remember traveling much farther than Brownsville, where my grandparents lived. But my love of reading and the strong community I found at our local YMCA made it feel bigger. I had a lot of support along the way to earn a full football scholarship to Baylor and eventually make it to the NFL – I think that's what makes me so committed to fighting for today's kids. I don't want my story to be the exception; I want every kid to be supported and empowered to succeed.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81913379/463894803/1744507883?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk367-fr-welcome&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzcxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjU4N2FjYi1lNWVkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c1c7xz6U08ok5Mw0eGpVV_65UpR9xN9kgFzVJ1BDGAE=)
My wife, Aly, and our two boys inspire me to work harder and dream bigger every day. When we decided to have kids, I knew from day one that I wanted to be there for every moment, and I wanted us to be equal partners. That's a big part of what inspired me to become the first member of Congress to take paternity leave and make fighting for paid family leave a key priority.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81913380/463894804/1744507883?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk367-fr-welcome&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzcxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjU4N2FjYi1lNWVkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c1c7xz6U08ok5Mw0eGpVV_65UpR9xN9kgFzVJ1BDGAE=)
I'm telling you all this because it's all a big part of why I'm running for Senate – to fight for families like yours and mine. And, yes, as a fourth-generation Texan, I'm also sick and tired of watching Ted Cruz trample over our rights and embarrass the Lone Star State every chance he gets. **Peter, I know Texans are ready for change, and I've taken down guys a lot tougher than Ted Cruz before. But I need your help.**
Experts are calling Texas a battleground state, saying this could be one of the most competitive and most expensive races this cycle. It's going to take a historic outpouring of grassroots support to beat Ted Cruz, and I don't want to risk losing because we didn't have the resources we needed. name: Dr. Cornel West for President 2024
subject: A heartfelt call for truly progressive compassion
body:
I invite you, with open arms and an open heart, to envision a new paradigm with us. Let's collectively cultivate a vision that's truly progressive – one that honors our fellow human beings, both at home and across the globe.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/progressive_courage_2024?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=progressive_courage_fundraiser&n=1)
---
My Dear Brothers and Sisters, **In these trying times, when the political arena is starkly divided by those who prioritize profit over our people and this beautiful planet, we find ourselves at a crossroads.** The choice they present us with – akin to selecting between civil war and genocide, between embracing fear or harboring hate, between fostering hostility or breeding indifference – is a false dichotomy that seeks to undermine the very fabric of our collective humanity. My heart grows heavy as we bear witness to the relentless march of aggression, greed, and exploitation, leaving indelible scars on the souls of our global family.
## **Summon the Courage of a True Progressive**
**I invite you, with open arms and an open heart, to envision a new paradigm with us.** Let's collectively cultivate a vision that's truly **progressive** – one that honors our fellow human beings, both at home and across the globe.
* **Progress** , my friends, begins with a resolute rejection of these false dichotomies. It's rooted in division, hate, fear, and greed. Together, we stand united in our commitment to the universal truths of equality, the inherent dignity of every human life, social justice, and the power of goodwill.

* **Progress** is about imagining the realm of possibilities – not confining ourselves to what the status quo dictates. It's a societal commitment to push forward in solidarity until every last one of us is free from the chains of injustice, exploitation, or violence.

* **Progress** demands that we hold our leaders accountable, regardless of their political stripes, especially when the stakes involve the lives and futures of entire communities and cultures.

* **Progress** requires an outright rejection of cynicism and the sense of futility, refusing to engage in the toxic practice of choosing the “lesser evil” when all options laid before us involve the dehumanization and suffering of our brothers and sisters – whether they're at our militarized borders, within our neglected neighborhoods, or victims of our deadly interventions abroad.

* **Progress** will not allow us to be misled into viewing independent voices as adversaries. The rhetoric that urges us not to “split the vote” between two fundamentally flawed options is not the language of the liberated or the brave.

* **Progress** means we move past the tired fears of “splitting the vote.” A new generation of voters is outright rejecting these false choices, and disenfranchised communities are now mobilizing to dismantle a system that has long failed to represent the interests of the people.

**At this pivotal moment, both choices offered by the corporate-backed duopoly stand in stark opposition to the moral compass that guides most Americans.**
## In these moments of reflection, I humbly ask you to stand with us:

clean_body: $100 million will be spent to defeat WFP champions and Squad members | | | Peter, AIPAC is one of the most formidable dark-money groups active in U.S. politics. According to Open Secrets , they spent $18 million in the 2022 cycle to prop up and elect extremist Republicans and conservatives-disguised-as-Democrats. And with more than 7 months left in the 2024 cycle, that number has already jumped to $26 million.1 But all of it pales in comparison to the $100 million they’ve pledged to spend to defeat Squad members and WFP champions like Jamaal Bowman, Summer Lee, Cori Bush, and more. Like other right-wing dark money groups, AIPAC believes they can take money from Republican megadonors and use it to drown out our voices. And if we don’t take their threat seriously, we might prove them right. Over the past several years, we have fought tooth and nail to grow the progressive bench in Congress and elect working-class champions to office, all while blocking the authoritarian threat from MAGA and the right. It has been grueling work. And we know how exhausted many of us are. But slowly, that hard work has been paying off. Over the past few years we’ve won inspiring victories for working class candidates at the local, state, and federal level around the country — wins that didn’t seem possible even ten years ago. Now groups like AIPAC and the Republican megadonors who fund them want to unravel all of that progress. They are vocally and obsessively opposed to virtually ALL progressive policies — and want to defeat candidates like our champions who have stood with their communities in calling for a ceasefire in Gaza, but also on issues like health care, climate change, student debt, and more. We didn’t put in all this work to elect these leaders just to see them pushed out by dark Republican money at the 11th hour. It’s going to take a team effort to fend off these attacks, but we’ve done it before, and with your support in moments like this, we know we can do it again. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , Open Secrets, 2024 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Here's some of what I've learned on the trail! | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81920548/463913243/1655983737?refcode=EM_FL_EHA_20240329_fr_EOQ5_cand_mf_30da_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTgxZWE0My1lY2VkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UcZKHrltkFseS6ghdj024KXznVI-qsTml6Qsh3z6g-w=)

Hey co-pilot – The first time I ran for office, it was like I was back in Army basic training – there's a lot of slang to learn. In the Army, it was things like FOBs and OERs. In campaigns, it was FOs and GOTV. Well, here are 2 important campaign acronyms we're talking about a lot right now: FEC and EOQ. **FEC is the Federal Election Commission.** They enforce campaign laws. _And every quarter, we have to file a campaign finance report with them on how much we've raised and spent._ They then publish them for _everyone_ – including you! – to see. (I think it's actually a pretty cool part of our elections.) **EOQ is end-of-quarter.** It's the big fundraising period that happens before each FEC reporting deadline. March is our first end-of-quarter in 2024 AND our last one before our primary in April. [We've only got 2 days left in this EOQ before we have to file our first FEC report of 2024. P.S. If you want to know what all those other acronyms are...
* FOB = Forward Operating Base, a type of military base close to the front line
* OER = Officer Evaluation Report, I got one every year as an Army officer
* FO = Field Organizer, the staff who recruit and organize volunteers to turn out voters
* GOTV = Get Out The Vote, the 6-8 weeks before Election Day when campaigns call + text + knock on your door to remind you to vote

clean_body: WTF are the FEC and EOQ? Here's some of what I've learned on the trail! | = Hey co-pilot – The first time I ran for office, it was like I was back in Army basic training – there's a lot of slang to learn. In the Army, it was things like FOBs and OERs. In campaigns, it was FOs and GOTV. Well, here are 2 important campaign acronyms we're talking about a lot right now: FEC and EOQ. FEC is the Federal Election Commission. They enforce campaign laws. And every quarter, we have to file a campaign finance report with them on how much we've raised and spent. They then publish them for everyone – including you! – to see. (I think it's actually a pretty cool part of our elections.) EOQ is end-of-quarter. It's the big fundraising period that happens before each FEC reporting deadline. March is our first end-of-quarter in 2024 AND our last one before our primary in April. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Thanks for being in this fight with me as my co-pilot, Ashley 🚁 P.S. If you want to know what all those other acronyms are... FOB = Forward Operating Base, a type of military base close to the front line OER = Officer Evaluation Report, I got one every year as an Army officer FO = Field Organizer, the staff who recruit and organize volunteers to turn out voters GOTV = Get Out The Vote, the 6-8 weeks before Election Day when campaigns call + text + knock on your door to remind you to vote = | Ashley Ehasz is a U.S. Army veteran, Apache helicopter pilot, and proudly pro-choice Democrat running to unseat Republican Brian Fitzpatrick and represent Pennsylvania’s 1st Congressional District to defend our democracy, restore reproductive rights, tackle corporate greed, advocate for bold gun safety measures, and fight for working families across southeast PA. | = | Paid for by Ehasz for Congress Ehasz for Congress 1800 Byberry Road #1336 Bensalem, PA 19020 United States Ashley Ehasz is a former member of the U.S. Army. | Hi Friend,
Democrat Stuart Whitlow here. MAGA Republicans like my opponent, John Carter, just showed how cruel their extreme agenda will be if they remain in power.
If Republicans win control of Congress and the White House this election, no one will escape their vindictive plans. Not even our nation's seniors.
John Carter is already pushing to raise the Social Security retirement age and slash seniors' benefits. As President Biden said, this "shows what Republicans value" -- and it's not working folks like us.

Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards.
At this make-or-break moment, I’m counting on grassroots conservatives and supporters like you to show the world that Republicans are not giving up and our passion to save our country is stronger than ever!

We understand these are challenging times financially, but the future of our district and country is at stake. We need your help now more than ever. Please consider donating today to help us get through the primary election on May 14th here in Maryland.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!

| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4be4ff56-2836-42ef-9f62-720131333a97/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T33b158b6-7143-487a-8643-cb69c3ed6e56/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I’m always saying that my campaign to keep representing Alaska in Congress is a tossup. Here’s what that _really_ means:
* I have **multiple opponents already running against me,** and there’s still plenty of time for more opponents to jump in the race.
* **Every single vote I take in Washington is scrutinized,** spun, and used to attack me by those who want to unseat me.
* **Dark money groups are digging through video clips of me as we speak,** trying to find footage of me saying things they can use in attack ads and take out of context.
* Special interest groups are already **blasting me in attack ads,** and spending money to lay the groundwork for my defeat.

**Peter, running in such a competitive race is exhausting, stressful, and challenging. But I’m up for the challenge because there’s few things I love more than giving Alaskans a seat at the table in Washington**. I’m in this no matter the odds, but I can only win with your support, Peter – because we can only defeat these special interest millions together. [**Can you split a donation of $25 between Blue Amp Action and I before midnight to help me win this competitive seat again and fend off these constant attacks? >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0b5d2273-bf46-4baa-8f80-657ee42eedac/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. Friend -- At 1:30 am on March 26th, a cargo ship leaving the Port of Baltimore lost power and hit a pylon supporting Baltimore's Francis Scott Key Bridge, which bridge then simply folded, and completely collapsed within 4 seconds. [Watch here.](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=2PNlHEbVYFsh-F_FzIY8nVpWUa4Lhd-BlpfSvEwGMbM&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=symposium_march_29_what_happen&n=2) The 1.6 mile long bridge, completed in 1977, was named for the author of the American national anthem, Francis Scott Key. Key had written the "The Star Spangled Banner", while watching the British attack on Fort McHenry and Baltimore during the War of 1812. "Will our flag still wave?" asked Key. The Francis Scott Key Bridge was the second longest steel arch continuous through truss bridge in the US, and the third longest such bridge in the world. It was a critical transportation link around the outer harbor of Baltimore, connecting New York and Washington. The bridge played a major role in the Port of Baltimore and with what had been, at one time, the powerful industrial capabilities of the area. So, what happened? The Sare symposium tonight, March 29, will discuss the issues behind the bridge's total collapse, including the current state of American infrastructure, the relation of infrastructure to the collapsing industrial capability of the nation, and the misdirection of American industrial capabilities and talents into unending wars.
### [New York Symposium, March 29, 2024--Why Did the Francis Scott Key Bridge Collapse?](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=2PNlHEbVYFsh-F_FzIY8nf3bD7p0BJFSHIn67JJrlEI&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=symposium_march_29_what_happen&n=3)

clean_body: | | Friend -- At 1:30 am on March 26th, a cargo ship leaving the Port of Baltimore lost power and hit a pylon supporting Baltimore's Francis Scott Key Bridge, which bridge then simply folded, and completely collapsed within 4 seconds. The 1.6 mile long bridge, completed in 1977, was named for the author of the American national anthem, Francis Scott Key. Key had written the "The Star Spangled Banner", while watching the British attack on Fort McHenry and Baltimore during the War of 1812. "Will our flag still wave?" asked Key. The Francis Scott Key Bridge was the second longest steel arch continuous through truss bridge in the US, and the third longest such bridge in the world. It was a critical transportation link around the outer harbor of Baltimore, connecting New York and Washington. The bridge played a major role in the Port of Baltimore and with what had been, at one time, the powerful industrial capabilities of the area. So, what happened? The Sare symposium tonight, March 29, will discuss the issues behind the bridge's total collapse, including the current state of American infrastructure, the relation of infrastructure to the collapsing industrial capability of the nation, and the misdirection of American industrial capabilities and talents into unending wars. .. | "DONATE" \--Diane | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Sare for Senate

body:
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5vBj19AEOSKdlmK46MsY4g~~/AARclAA~/RgRn6ZQaP0SjaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9uYXRpb25hbC1jb25zdGl0dXRpb25hbC1sYXctdW5pb24vcmViZWNjYS1qNi1tYi1wb3BhP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmViZWNjYS1qNiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPXBvcGEmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW1iJnV0bV90Yz1ST04yLTIwMjQwMzI5JmFtb3VudD0yNVcDc3BjQgpmBI_3BmZH6F3OUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

Rebecca drove 25 hours across our nation to attend the January 6th Rally in 2021. Three years later, she faces three years in federal prison and fines of up to $200,000. Why? [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5vBj19AEOSKdlmK46MsY4g~~/AARclAA~/RgRn6ZQaP0SjaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9uYXRpb25hbC1jb25zdGl0dXRpb25hbC1sYXctdW5pb24vcmViZWNjYS1qNi1tYi1wb3BhP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmViZWNjYS1qNiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPXBvcGEmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW1iJnV0bV90Yz1ST04yLTIwMjQwMzI5JmFtb3VudD0yNVcDc3BjQgpmBI_3BmZH6F3OUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Dear Patriot,

Rebecca Lavrenz is a registered nurse and mother proud of her six grandchildren and one great-grandson.

She is a patriot who loves her country and will fight for it peacefully.

Rebecca drove 25 hours across our nation to attend the January 6th Rally in 2021.

Three years later, she faces three years in federal prison and fines of up to $200,000.

Why? She walked into the Nation's Capital for 10 minutes. She followed a crowd who stepped in without police telling them to stop. She said nothing while in the building and damaged nothing. She prayed to "bring God inside the Capitol" with her presence and prayers.

My name is John Pierce, and I represent Rebecca and over 30 other January 6th defendants **[who need your help](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5vBj19AEOSKdlmK46MsY4g~~/AARclAA~/RgRn6ZQaP0SjaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9uYXRpb25hbC1jb25zdGl0dXRpb25hbC1sYXctdW5pb24vcmViZWNjYS1qNi1tYi1wb3BhP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmViZWNjYS1qNiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPXBvcGEmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW1iJnV0bV90Yz1ST04yLTIwMjQwMzI5JmFtb3VudD0yNVcDc3BjQgpmBI_3BmZH6F3OUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~).**

My organization, the National Constitutional Law Union, has been fighting for these Americans on shoestring budgets for years while facing the unstoppable Goliath, the Department of Justice.

Biden's DOJ is making us fight every step of the way. They refuse to produce discovery and the 302s of the FBI's interviews related to Rebecca's case. A 302 is a form used by the FBI to summarize an interview, and since they don't record interviews to protect themselves, the 302 is a key piece of evidence needed to vindicate my client.

And the DOJ and FBI do this regularly, requiring me to ask a judge to compel them to produce evidence that should have been handed over before trial.

Why do they do this?

To wear me out. The more filings and hearings needed to defend these Americans add to the expense and time. We have limited resources, and as you know, our Department of Justice has no limit to what it's willing to spend to imprison any American who stepped foot on Capital grounds on January 6th.

Rebecca Lavrenz did no harm and is a victim of Biden's zealous mission to send one message to the American people. That message is this: "NEVER stand up to your government!"

But their message is falling on deaf ears, and **[I need your help to send a message right back to them](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/5vBj19AEOSKdlmK46MsY4g~~/AARclAA~/RgRn6ZQaP0SjaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9uYXRpb25hbC1jb25zdGl0dXRpb25hbC1sYXctdW5pb24vcmViZWNjYS1qNi1tYi1wb3BhP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9cmViZWNjYS1qNiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPXBvcGEmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW1iJnV0bV90Yz1ST04yLTIwMjQwMzI5JmFtb3VudD0yNVcDc3BjQgpmBI_3BmZH6F3OUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** by saving this Christian grandmother from federal prison.

Thanks to young Americans like you, we've claimed major victories. Here are just a few examples of what we've accomplished together so far:
