If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election years in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing my end-of-quarter goal would be sending****a crystal clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.** **[_So please, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. to help me continue our fight for progress this year? clean_body: whatever you can spare | | | Friend, I wanted to reach out to personally thank you. I have so much to thank you for, so this message is a bit longer than usual. But in case you're short on time, I have to make sure that you see this first: My end-of-quarter deadline is approaching, and we're still pacing dangerously short of my $100,000 goal.= | | = If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins. In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible. I alsoreleased my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability. From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen. I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our Constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom. Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve. There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12687882?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

Thank you for joining me for another weekly update! Following the 2024 Legislative Session, it has been full speed ahead back in the district. I have had several opportunities to speak at events, participate in legislative updates, and visit with constituents. Being a legislator is a full-time job! I will continue to stay busy in the upcoming weeks and look forward to keeping you updated.

I want to thank you for your continued trust and support! You are the reason my service to House District 24 and Florida is possible. As always, if there is something I can do for you, please do not hesitate to reach out to my office. I want to hear from you!
---
| | **Tuesday, March 26**
---
|
---
| I had the pleasure of attending Belleview on the Rise! This was the very first breakfast held by the new Belleview Chamber of Economic Partnership. I look forward to the chamber’s success and future Belleview CEP events.
---
|
---
| It was an honor to meet with a group of Real Estate Entrepreneurs to give a legislative update and discuss legislation related to the real estate industry. I always enjoy sharing with the community about the work my fellow House members and I accomplished during the legislative session in Tallahassee.
---
|
---
---
| I was excited to attend the grand opening of my friend Emory Abshier’s Ellianos Coffee in Belleview. Congratulations to him on this achievement! They are celebrating all week long, so please make the effort to stop by and support this great business in District 24.
---
|
---
---
| I had the privilege of speaking to the members of the Stone Creek Republican Club to give a legislative update and answer questions regarding my work as State Representative. Thank you to Greg Ratliff and the other club members for inviting me!
---
|
---
| To end the day, my wife, Jenny, and I had the opportunity to attend an event in Ocala supporting the re-election of Kat Cammack. The congresswoman has done incredible work for our state in Washington, and I look forward to her winning big in November.
---
| | **Wednesday, March 27**
---
|
---
---
| It was great to speak at the Oak Run Republican Club to give a legislative update and answer any questions and concerns they had regarding the legislative session. I am grateful to Bob Schmidt and the rest of the club for the warm welcome and support.
---
| | **Happy Easter!**
---
|
---
| Happy Easter, District 24! On Sunday, we will celebrate the grace and mercy Jesus offered us when He died on the cross. We live because He lives. Wishing many blessings on you and your family this weekend. He is risen!

“Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.” 1 Peter 1:3
---

| | Hi there,
I wanted to pass along my latest Op-Ed in the Coronado News: [_Addressing our problems requires courage, conviction and action_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=f315b93cf7&e=784f78234b). I’ve got experience dealing with the problems we’re facing that Terra Lawson-Remer refuses to address like homelessness.
Under my tenure, San Diego became the only big city in California that actually saw a reduction in homelessness by double digits. Using the same tactics and approach as I did as Mayor will be critical at the County level where I intend to lead starting on Day 1.
# —
# -Kevin

# [My Latest Op-Ed In The Coronado News](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=bb4e50e153&e=784f78234b):

# _Addressing our problems requires courage, conviction and action_

Our region is facing some of the most unprecedented challenges that demand our attention and it’s imperative that we confront them with compassion, action and unwavering resolve.
San Diego County is at the crossroads of two pressing crises: homelessness and an environmental crisis, particularly from the sewage flowing from the Tijuana River Valley polluting our pristine beaches.
_**Contaminated waters**_
For decades, millions of gallons of sewage, sediment and trash have contaminated our waters off our southernmost beaches, posing a significant threat to public health and environmental integrity. This issue has prompted frustration among residents and visitors alike – and for good reason. It’s an environmental nightmare that deserves our attention.
As Mayor of San Diego, I successfully urged federal leaders in the U.S. and Mexico to take action to protect our region from sewage overflows in the Tijuana River Valley.We did it in a bipartisan fashion, securing $300 million set aside through the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) coupled with the implementation of new pumps and waste diversion systems.
I invited the EPA to our region to see for themselves just how dire the crisis had become and how polluted our beautiful beaches had become. As a result, they installed infrastructure to help reduce pollution flowing into our beaches.As supervisor, I will continue working in a bipartisan manner with our local mayors as well as our state and federal delegations to ensure we receive the proper attention and funding to prevent more sewage from flowing onto our beaches.
_**Addressing homelessness**_
Our most pressing issue in the San Diego region is homelessness. Since I left office, homelessness throughout San Diego has exploded. Open air drug markets rule our streets with dangerous drugs like fentanyl running rampant. In 2023, homelessness jumped 14% with over 10,000 people living on our streets, according to data from the Regional Task Force on Homelessness (RTFH).
What’s worse, over 500 people died on our streets last year from various causes including drug overdose. Every day that goes by without meaningful action, things get worse.
When I was Mayor, I tackled our homeless crisis with compassion and action. As a result San Diego became the only major city in California where homelessness decreased by double digits, according to the 2020 Point-in-Time (PIT) count results.
We achieved this by opening hundreds of safe beds, establishing shelters with access to mental health services and addiction treatment, and facilitating pathways to long-term housing for men, women, families and veterans in need. We created a new neighborhood policing division dedicated to protecting and improving quality of life on our streets.
We did not allow tent encampments on our sidewalks, prioritizing the cleanliness of our public spaces. Why? Because in San Diego we cared enough about people to not let them die on our streets – that’s clearly not what is happening today with Terra Lawson-Remer, who refuses to treat homelessness as the emergency that it is. How many more homeless people need to die for this to be her top priority?
As supervisor, I’ll treat homelessness as the emergency that it is. I’ll insist on employing policies like right to shelter with an obligation to use it. I’ll work with the Board of Supervisors to lead when it comes to opening new bridge shelters instead of allowing our cities to struggle alone with this problem.
We’ll expand access to mental health services and addiction treatment, implement proven solutions to provide safe shelter and support, and cut through bureaucratic red tape to expedite housing placements to get people off the streets and into a safe place of their own.
The issues we face demand courage, conviction, and action. I have a record addressing them all while bringing positive change and tangible results. Unfortunately, we’re not seeing any of this from our current supervisor, Terra Lawson-Remer. To get to where we need to be, making progress on the pressing issues like the homelessness and the sewage crisis, it’s important we make a change, and it starts this November by retiring Terra Lawson-Remer.
_Kevin Faulconer served as the 36th mayor of San Diego, California, from 2014 to 2020. Born in San Jose, California, Faulconer left office in December of 2020 and has continued his never-ending service to San Diego, focusing on helping address the homeless health and safety crisis._
_**Read the Op-Ed**_[ _**here**_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=7fe622f6f5&e=784f78234b) _**.**_
_**To learn more about Kevin Faulconer’s campaign for Supervisor, please visit**_[ _**www.kevinfaulconer.com**_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=78c65ea4b0&e=784f78234b)

name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: Remember that feeling?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
Think about when you first learned about gerrymandering.
|
---

Friends,
I want you to take a moment with me and think about the first time you learned about gerrymandering — think about how you felt when you realized just how obviously wrong and backward it is to have such a thing in a representative democracy.
If you’re anything like me, you might remember asking yourself, _“How could our system allow for such blatant manipulation?”_
**But instead of choosing to let that feeling disillusion us or make us cynical, we chose to do something about it. When President Obama and I joined forces to launch All On The Line five years ago, it was with the goal of pushing back against a broken status quo, and building a more representative democracy for all Americans**.**You’ve been right there with us, and that’s truly powerful.**

| Friends, Today is Good Friday. It's the day we remember our Lord Jesus Christ was buried in a tomb. It's a solemn day of reflection. Nothing can take away from this sacred and holy day.
It's also the day I spent 2 hours with my criminal defense attorney and wrote a check for $5,000 for them to defend me against a politically motivated assault and battery charge and a protective order intended to strip me of my ability to carry a firearm for personal protection.
That's right. Assault and batter. That's a class 1 misdemeanor. Up to $2,500 in fees.
Now they've filed a protective order in an attempt to take away my basic right to protect myself. Like you, I don't have a security detail to protect myself. I rely on the 2nd Amendment and the personal right to carry. They want to make me a defenseless target for my opponents and enemies who are determined to take me out.
Now I have to appear in General District Court for a criminal offense. The same tactics they used on Trump, they are using on me. Only I don't have millions to fight this.
You know me. I'm going to stand up for myself when I've been wronged. They know that too.
The Sargeant of Arms, a vindictive ex-employee, had his girlfriend to harass me, provoke me and then catch my reaction on video. Thankfully, I kept my cool. Yet I still have to hire an attorney to prepare my defense.
Would you please consider donating to help cover my legal costs?
I'm not getting a paycheck anymore. And I simply don't have the funds for lawsuits.
Thanks to your generosity, today I wrote an initial $5,000 check to an attorney just so that I could defend my innocence in court.
Also, I now have to appear in court on May 13. If you witnessed this girlfriend trying to provoke me, would you please be willing to serve as witness for me on May 13? Please reply to this email and let me know.
Over 700 people were there at Swift Creek Middle School in Chesterfield County voting in our firehouse primary to elect new Chesterfield GOP leadership.
Please also consider giving to my defense fund. Any amount is appreciated and will help pay for legal costs associated with my defense. Many thanks to those who have already donated.

Good Friday— the day Jesus said, "It is finished." His death on the cross made a way for us to experience life everlasting. **_Today we are announcing the grand finale of the Kingdom to the Capitol Tour_**. On October 26th, Let Us Worship is capping off all 50 states in our nation's capitol. The timing is no coincidence— we are finishing the tour just days before the presidential election and we're gonna call America to the cross! Below is a powerful scene from Let Us Worship's 2020 D.C. revival— thousands running to the cross to give their lives to Jesus. THIS is why He did what He did, and we are eternally grateful! Mark your calendars for October 26th, and get ready to watch Him move again!!

body:
#
Alexandria is always sure to fact-check billionaire Elon Musk when he spreads disinformation and propaganda on Twitter, sorry ‘X’.
So last night, after Musk shared a right-wing, anti-immigration article and accused Dems of ‘importing voters’ to influence elections, AOC had to remind him:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240329-1.0dOxC6&refcode=em20240329-6104-P_FND_RES_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6104%2E2526796%2Er3U-xF)
**Elon and billionaires just like him are terrified that our progressive movement for justice and equality is growing.**
They spread propaganda about immigration — and universal healthcare, and a Green New Deal — to rile up their extremist supporters ahead of the election.
[If you want to help Alexandria grow our movement (and tick off Elon Musk even more), will you chip in $5 to our fight today? Every dollar goes to our campaign to power our ‘extreme left’ agenda to uplift working families.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240329-1.0dOxC6&refcode=em20240329-6104-P_FND_RES_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6104%2E2526796%2Er3U-xF)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240329-1.0dOxC6&refcode=em20240329-6104-P_FND_RES_TWT&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6104%2E2526796%2Er3U-xF)**
And here are the latest **facts** on immigration: according to new estimates, immigration will expand our workforce by 5.2 million people, contributing an additional $7 trillion to our economy in the next ten years.
And as more, working-age immigrants arrive in our country to seek employment, our aging population will be able to retire with dignity while our economy continues to grow.1
Together, we’ll send a message that our movement is more powerful than far-right billionaire propaganda.
Pa’lante,
Team AOC
1 - [**Business Insider** : The US economy will grow by an extra $7 trillion over the next decade due to immigration, the CBO says](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/22283?t=22&akid=6104%2E2526796%2Er3U-xF)

And as more, working-age immigrants arrive in our country to seek employment, our aging population will be able to retire with dignity while our economy continues to grow.1 Together, we’ll send a message that our movement is more powerful than far-right billionaire propaganda. Pa’lante, Team AOC 1 - | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

name: Team Alsobrooks
subject: Here's your Weekly Team Alsobrooks Newsletter, Peter!
body:
Greetings #TeamAlsobrooks!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16224?t=1001&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

We are expressing our deepest condolences to the families of the victims
of the devastating Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse. We grieve with the
families of Alejandro Hernandez Fuentes and Dorlian Ronial Castillo
Cabrera, who lost their lives during the accident. We continue to pray for
the victims – including those still missing, their families, and the
people of Baltimore. We must stand together to uplift the Baltimore region
as they recover from this horrific event.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16224?t=1002&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]Donate to the families impacted by the key bridge collapse here.

From the Campaign Trail and Beyond...

As the great former Senator Barbara Mikulski said, “Each one of us can
make a difference. Together we make change.” Team Alsobrooks is doing just
that. We are truly amazed to have the support of so many Marylanders. Our
grassroots movement is key to keeping the Senate blue and defeating
Senator Mitch McConnell’s hand-picked candidate Larry Hogan come November.

In case you missed it, Team Alsobrooks has been honored to have earned
some critical endorsements in this race, just in the last week. Here are
some highlights:

Monday, Angela was endorsed by Congressman Jamie Raskin. In a [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16225?t=1003&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]video
announcing his support, Rep Raskin said:

“I’m supporting Angela Alsobrooks for the U.S. Senate because she’s going
to deliver for the people of Maryland everyday while defending democracy
and freedom against Donald Trump and his MAGA party. She can defeat Larry
Hogan in November and prevent extremists from taking control of the
Senate.”

We are proud to have him on our team. You can find more about why Rep.
Raskin endorsed Angela in this [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16226?t=1004&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]Washington Post article.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1031&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

Angela was also proud to receive endorsements from Congressional Black
Caucus members, Congresswoman Barbara Lee (CA-12), Congresswoman Joyce
Beatty (OH-03), Congressman Gregory Meeks (NY-5), Congresswoman Yvette D.
Clarke (NY-9), and Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett (TX-30), longtime public
servants who are supporting Angela because of her record of getting things
done for Maryland.

“I am thrilled to endorse Angela Alsobrooks for U.S. Senate. Angela is not
just a leader; she's a trailblazer who has consistently stood up for
families and worked tirelessly for the betterment of Maryland,” said
Congresswoman Clarke. “Her vision and integrity make her the best choice
to represent Maryland in the Senate, where I am confident she will
continue to fight for justice and equality.”

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1038&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

Angela also earned the endorsement of former Prince George’s County
Executive, Rushern Baker. In a [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16227?t=1005&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]Washington Post article, Mr Baker said:

“I’m supporting my good friend Angela to be Maryland’s next United States
Senator because I worked alongside her for eight years and I know her
heart and her passion for serving people. Angela has the knowledge,
temperament and vision to lead Maryland forward when she gets to the
Senate. I’m getting off the sidelines now because I believe she is the
strongest candidate to take on Larry Hogan in the General Election. We
need a disciplined candidate who can turn out the Democratic base. That’s
why I’m all in for Angela, and I encourage all Prince Georgians and
Marylanders to join me.”

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1039&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

Team Alsobrooks is appreciative to Rep. Raskin, Rep. Lee, Rep. Meeks, Rep.
Beatty, Rep. Clarke, Rep. Crockett, and Mr. Baker for their kind and
powerful words. We are thrilled to have the support of people who have
dedicated their lives to improving their communities. Team Alsobrooks is
taking that energy all the way to Capitol Hill!

This race will be won by the power of the many, not the power of money. In
order to win, we need people across Maryland to come together and support
our grassroots campaign by telling their friends and neighbors about
Angela, making calls, and knocking on doors. Marylanders deserve a Senator
who will fight for equality, economic opportunity for all of our
communities, access to affordable healthcare, and safe communities.

Last Friday, there was great energy at the New Psalmist Baptist Church and
League of Women Voters Forum in Baltimore. As our campaign continues to
grow, we remain committed to going farther and doing better for every
Marylander in our State.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1040&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

Angela’s dad, Mac Alsobrooks, has been campaigning by her side since her
first election in 2010, and Team Alsobrooks is lucky to have his energy
behind us! Last Saturday, he hosted a phenomenal Men for Alsobrooks event
in Upper Marlboro.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1041&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

While in Frederick we had a robust conversation about what can be done to
improve the livelihoods of Veterans in Maryland. Our vets have served our
country and now that they’re back home it’s crucial we give them the
resources they deserve to be successful and healthy.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1042&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

The energy at our meet and greet in Frederick was electric! We are elated
to have earned the support of so many people and communities across our
state.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1043&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1044&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

We attended the Hispanic Chamber of Commerce’s U.S. Senate Candidate
Forum. Every community and Marylander deserves a Senator who listens to
their concerns and fights like everything for them. Angela plans to go
farther and do better for every single Marylander.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1045&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

We had a very important discussion with a group of women in Frederick
about the necessity to expand access to reproductive medicine and to
protect IVF. Thank you to everyone who came out and shared their stories.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1032&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

What a blessing to participate in Palm Sunday Services at Mount Pleasant
Baptist Church in Baltimore City/County. It was so great to join others in
fellowship on such a Holy day.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1033&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

We were overjoyed to attend a gathering hosted by Sen. Shelly Hettleman in
Owings Mills. We are in awe of all she does for women throughout Maryland,
fighting for abortion rights and access to reproductive care - it is so
wonderful to have her support in this race. Pleasure seeing our friends
Councilman Julian Jones and Delegate N. Scott Phillips as always!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1034&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

We had an excellent time attending the Omicron Phi Zeta Chapter of Zeta
Phi Beta’s P.E.A.R.L Anniversary. Thank you for inviting us to celebrate
with all of you on this wonderful occasion!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1035&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

What an honor to be in Annapolis to give remarks at the Michelle Obama
Awards and Women’s History Month Celebration! This year’s honorees have
all done tremendous work promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion in
their communities, and are paving the path for the next generation of
leaders in Maryland.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15948?t=1036&amount=25&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ][IMG]

UPCOMING EVENTS

Thursday, April 4th (Annapolis) – Organizing Meeting! – [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15398?t=1006&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]RSVP Here
Thursday, April 4th (Towson) – Support Angela at the League of
Conservation Voters Forum – [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16798?t=1007&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]RSVP Here
Saturday, April 6th (Baltimore) – Baltimore Organizing House Party –
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16799?t=1008&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]RSVP Here
Saturday, April 6th (Odenton) – Knock on Doors in Odenton with Angela –
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16800?t=1009&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]RSVP Here
Saturday, April 6th (Largo) – Knock on Doors in Largo with Angela –
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16801?t=1010&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]RSVP Here
Tuesday, April 9th (Waldorf) – All in for Angela: Southern Maryland –
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16802?t=1011&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]RSVP Here
Wednesday, April 10th (Bowie) – All in for Angela : Prince George’s County
– [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16803?t=1012&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]RSVP Here
Wednesday April 10th (College Park) – Get Out the Vote at UMD – [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16804?t=1013&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]RSVP
Here

NEWS OF THE WEEK

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15401?t=1014&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]WBAL: 'This race is far from over': Political science professor weighs
in on status of US Senate Race
“One day after a Washington Post poll was released, Democratic U.S. Senate
candidate Angela Alsobrooks' campaign released a new ad focusing on her
work as a former prosecutor.”

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16805?t=1015&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]New York Times: Angela Alsobrooks Picks Up Senate Endorsements After
Opponent Uses Racial Slur
“Five House members backed Ms. Alsobrooks over their colleague”

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16806?t=1016&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]Fox 45: Congressional Black Caucus members endorse Alsobrooks
“Alsobrooks was endorsed by Congresswoman Barbara Lee (CA-12), Congressman
Gregory Meeks (NY-5), Congresswoman Joyce Beatty (OH-3), Congresswoman
Yvette D. Clarke (NY-9), and Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett (TX-30).”

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16226?t=1017&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]The Washington Post: Rep. Jamie Raskin endorses Alsobrooks in
high-stakes Md. Senate race
“‘Who do we want on the floor of the U.S. Senate defending women’s right
to choose? I want Angela Alsobrooks,’ Raskin said. ‘Who do we want
defending the right of the people to vote? I want Angela Alsobrooks. This
is not a time anyone can afford to sit on the sidelines.’”

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16227?t=1018&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]Rushern Baker endorses Angela Alsobrooks in race for Maryland’s Senate
seat - The Washington Post
“I’m getting off the sidelines [because] this is a critical point for not

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16807?t=1019&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]Maryland Matters: Political notes: Ad wars in CD-3, Alsobrooks and

“Alsobrooks announced the endorsement of U.S. Rep. Jamie Raskin (D-8th) —
one of the few public officials who may actually have the ability to move

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/16808?t=1020&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]WBAL: Maryland Congressman Raskin endorses Angela Alsobrooks in her

[ http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12441?t=1022&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]2. Text your friends using our Alsobrooks App!

[ http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/15324?t=1023&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]3. Sign up to watch the polls during Early Vote — May 2nd to May 9th!

campaign!

[ https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=1026&akid=1316%2E52803%2E6nhKPY ]Volunteer

Peter, SCOTUS is set to decide on a case that could lead to the ban of Mifepristone, one of two drugs used for medication abortion in the U.S. Mifepristone has been FDA-approved for 23 years. It’s safe. It’s effective. We’re at a pivotal moment in this race, Derek:
**My mega-millionaire opponent, David McCormick, just launched his first ad buy of the election cycle – a seven-figure spend that will blanket Pennsylvania’s airwaves.**
[**_There’s no time to waste. Can you split an emergency donation of any amount between my campaign and John Fetterman to help us fight back?_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49759?refcode=em20240329-8871&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8871%2E434096%2EhiUE0k)

This is where the rubber meets the road, Derek. My opponent is the wealthiest self-funder running for Senate anywhere in the country. Last cycle, he spent $14.3 million in the GOP primary, and he can spend even more this time around.
If we don’t have the resources to fight back, it could be the difference between a red and blue Senate. That’s not a risk I’m willing to take. We must protect this seat, but we can’t do it without you.

Bob Casey

clean_body: We're going to have to make up some serious ground in order to hit our Q1 goal by Easter Sunday | Peter, This is not what I thought March would look like. It’s Jim Jordan, and I’m at a loss for words. Every March before the quarterly fundraising deadline, online donors step up and support Republicans with the donations we need to win ... but that hasn’t happened yet, and I'm starting to worry. I’ve had to stop emailing/texting many of my former donors because not enough folks responded. Every single text/email between now and Saturday at midnight MUST raise more than it costs to send. I can’t say it enough: our success is directly tied to the support we receive from online donors. So please, God Bless, Jim Jordan | About Jim Jordan: Leading the fight to hold Washington accountable. In Washington, Jim Jordan is focused on his oversight role, helping lead investigations into federal agencies In Congress, Jim Jordan continued to fight for fiscal responsibility,and he offered the only balanced budget of any member of the House or Senate. As a state legislator, he took on the powerful special interests and the leaders from both political parties who wanted to put Ohio on an unsustainable path of higher taxes and spending. He built a conservative, pro-family voting record, and authored an alternative state budget that balanced without raising taxes. He became the only legislator in state history to win both the Defender of Life award from Ohio Right to Life and the Pro-Life Legislator of the Year award from the United Conservatives of Ohio. | Paid for by Jim Jordan for Congress PO BOX 355 Delaware, OH 43015

I'm coming to you personally to ask for your help because I see a lot of parallels between Debbie's story and mine. She is, without a doubt, the kind of leader Floridians deserve in a Senator.

Debbie grew up in a one room apartment, and her mother — an immigrant from Ecuador — worked tirelessly to provide a better life for Debbie and her sisters, so they could achieve their American dream. I grew up with six brothers and sisters in a two room house in Jacksonville. My mom worked as a maid, and my dad was a janitor. We both know what it means to work hard and persevere.

Debbie and I also grew up working minimum wage jobs, and yet we went on to serve in Congress together. We've dedicated our careers to public service because we want every Floridian to have the opportunities we had — to ensure the American dream is within reach for _each and every one of them._
But do you know who is standing in the way of the American dream for far too many Floridians? Our extremist Senator, Rick Scott, who is beholden to a disgraced, twice-impeached former president, Donald Trump.

A mere 35% of Floridians view Rick Scott favorably, friend. It's no wonder why. **But Scott spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this Senate seat in 2018, and he's already spent millions this time around in his efforts to repeat history.**

Experts everywhere are saying this will be one of the most competitive — _and expensive_ — races in the country. I know that Debbie can defeat Rick Scott and deliver the leadership Florida deserves, but only with the power of a grassroots movement fueled by people like you, friend. **[Please rush an urgent donation to help Debbie hit her $700,000 end-of-quarter fundraising goal, defeat Rick Scott, and protect our Democratic Senate majority!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81937187/463954475/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk996-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWRjOGQ0NTgtMDFlZS1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Rd1aLzSUnMPXPAhFJdBDB7m56JNO9bXW7ujA5BLIN_Q=)**

The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. _[If you were forwarded this newsletter, you can sign up to receive the Kernel every week by clicking here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81937925/463956574/1416943042?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1YzFkMy0wMmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eF9pKlkB1SRNzIxQjr_lZlwUjgtZZcjCz4hQTMAYWKw=&emci=74ac0548-f8ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=7d55c1d3-02ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=4925535)_ **** _Hoosier Democrats Launch Break the Supermajority Tour_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81937926/463956575/-1472318086?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1YzFkMy0wMmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eF9pKlkB1SRNzIxQjr_lZlwUjgtZZcjCz4hQTMAYWKw=&emci=74ac0548-f8ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=7d55c1d3-02ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=4925535)**[Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81937927/463956576/-1472318086?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1YzFkMy0wMmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eF9pKlkB1SRNzIxQjr_lZlwUjgtZZcjCz4hQTMAYWKw=&emci=74ac0548-f8ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=7d55c1d3-02ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=4925535) This week, Indiana Democrats made the first two stops of their Break the Supermajority Tour in Carmel and Fort Wayne. We showcased the work that Indiana’s pragmatic problem solvers at the Statehouse have done, and stressed the importance of winning four seats in the State House to bring real accountability to our state government.

Twelve straight years of a GOP supermajority has led to extreme policy, from restrictions on collective bargaining to the nation’s first post-Dobbs abortion ban. Winning those four seats would put more Democrats on committees and stop harmful legislation.
_INDems Mourn the Loss of Fort Wayne Mayor Tom Henry_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81937928/463956577/-1472318086?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1YzFkMy0wMmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eF9pKlkB1SRNzIxQjr_lZlwUjgtZZcjCz4hQTMAYWKw=&emci=74ac0548-f8ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=7d55c1d3-02ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=4925535)** IDP Chair Mike Schmuhl: “Mayor Henry embodied his city every single day, and he also transformed it during his historic tenure as mayor. Through charm, grit, humor and hard work, he led his hometown for over 16 years straight, a record. “While we grieve his passing and send our sincerest condolences to his beloved family, friends and the entire Fort Wayne community, we are also filled with peace knowing he is reunited with his partner in life, Cindy Henry."
_**_2024 Indiana Democratic Party Platform Input Tour: Input Due April 1, 2024_**_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81937929/463956578/406581856?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1YzFkMy0wMmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eF9pKlkB1SRNzIxQjr_lZlwUjgtZZcjCz4hQTMAYWKw=&emci=74ac0548-f8ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=7d55c1d3-02ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=4925535)** We’re getting ready to finalize our party platform for 2024, and we want your input! [Learn more about the input tour here, and submit your comments!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81937931/463956580/1709683047?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDU1YzFkMy0wMmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eF9pKlkB1SRNzIxQjr_lZlwUjgtZZcjCz4hQTMAYWKw=&emci=74ac0548-f8ed-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=7d55c1d3-02ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=4925535)

clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Hoosier Democrats Launch Break the Supermajority Tour This week, Indiana Democrats made the first two stops of their Break the Supermajority Tour in Carmel and Fort Wayne. We showcased the work that Indiana’s pragmatic problem solvers at the Statehouse have done, and stressed the importance of winning four seats in the State House to bring real accountability to our state government. Twelve straight years of a GOP supermajority has led to extreme policy, from restrictions on collective bargaining to the nation’s first post-Dobbs abortion ban. Winning those four seats would put more Democrats on committees and stop harmful legislation. INDems Mourn the Loss of Fort Wayne Mayor Tom Henry IDP Chair Mike Schmuhl: “Mayor Henry embodied his city every single day, and he also transformed it during his historic tenure as mayor. Through charm, grit, humor and hard work, he led his hometown for over 16 years straight, a record. “While we grieve his passing and send our sincerest condolences to his beloved family, friends and the entire Fort Wayne community, we are also filled with peace knowing he is reunited with his partner in life, Cindy Henry." 2024 Indiana Democratic Party Platform Input Tour: Input Due April 1, 2024 We’re getting ready to finalize our party platform for 2024, and we want your input! Hoosier Democrats are invited to provide feedback on our , and how we can make it even better and more representative of Indiana families this year! The final day to submit comments is April 1, 2024. Braun Says IVF Doesn’t Need Protection in Latest Debate The Republican candidates for governor held two debates this week, exposing their extreme views on reproductive healthcare. In particular, Senator Braun said that IVF doesn’t need protections because no one is coming after it. How wrong could he be? Mike Braun will not protect IVF if elected governor, threatening the ability for thousands of Hoosuiers to start a family. Jennifer McCormick knows we must protect IVF, and restore full reproductive freedom to Indiana. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. We are highlighting the work of Rep. Frank Mrvan, who secured critical funding to bring back to Northwest Indiana in the latest federal funding bill. This includes stormwater and sewer upgrades for Valparaiso and LaPorte. It also includes police funding for multiple communities in the Region, including Gary, Michigan City, Munster, and Hammond. Frank will keep working to bring projects and jobs to Northwest Indiana. This funding for police and critical infrastructure will move Northwest Indiana. Honoring the Life of Fort Wayne Mayor Tom Henry Fort Wayne and all of Indiana lost a tremendous public servant this week wth the passing of Fort Wayne Mayor Tom Henry. He served the city for over 40 years, and was a visonary leader who worked with all. Please view tributes to his life from Hoosier Democrats below. Become a Delegate to the 2024 State and National Conventions Stay up-to-date with the latest news and updates on the 2024 Delegate Selection process. Head to for more information about how to be a part of history next year in Chicago. Being part of this Rising cohort means receiving free individual support for developing your authentic message and effective tactics to win as well as connecting with other leaders in the Great Lakes states. Rising works with candidates for any level of office (local, state, or federal) in Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, and Illinois as well as staffers and volunteer activists who are helping their local campaigns. Friend, As Women’s History Month comes to a close, I’m committed to creating a more just and equitable world for women—from the U.S. to Palestine. At this month’s State of the Mama in Washington, DC, I joined legislators and Detroit’s Mothering Justice to discuss the urgent need for policies that support mothers and families, including access to affordable childcare, paid family leave, Black maternal health, and reproductive justice. I founded and co-chair the Congressional Mamas’ Caucus to focus on policies like these, because mothers of color and working class parents have been left behind. For example, more than 30 million U.S. workers do not have access to a single day of paid leave. That includes 67% of low-wage workers, most of whom are women and people of color. Most Americans still live paycheck to paycheck and can’t afford to lose their jobs. We know that the quickest way to end poverty and homelessness is by getting money directly into people’s pockets. That’s why I’ve introduced policies like the _End Child Poverty Act_ , which would provide families with a $428/month payment per child. My new bill, the _Youth Homelessness Guaranteed Income Pilot Program Act_ , would provide direct cash assistance as well. Young people with lived experience helped craft the bill to ensure that it meets the real needs of our unhoused neighbors. In the richest country in the history of the world, our communities should have what they need, like access to housing and clean water. I will continue demanding our government stop sending billions of dollars to weapons contractors and the Israeli military, and instead invest in our communities. clean_body: I will continue demanding our government stop sending billions to weapons contractors and the Israeli military, and instead invest in our communities. | | | Friend, As Women’s History Month comes to a close, I’m committed to creating a more just and equitable world for women—from the U.S. to Palestine. At this month’s State of the Mama in Washington, DC, I joined legislators and Detroit’s Mothering Justice to discuss the urgent need for policies that support mothers and families, including access to affordable childcare, paid family leave, Black maternal health, and reproductive justice. I founded and co-chair the Congressional Mamas’ Caucus to focus on policies like these, because mothers of color and working class parents have been left behind. For example, more than 30 million U.S. workers do not have access to a single day of paid leave. That includes 67% of low-wage workers, most of whom are women and people of color. Most Americans still live paycheck to paycheck and can’t afford to lose their jobs. We know that the quickest way to end poverty and homelessness is by getting money directly into people’s pockets. That’s why I’ve introduced policies like the End Child Poverty Act , which would provide families with a $428/month payment per child. My new bill, the Youth Homelessness Guaranteed Income Pilot Program Act , would provide direct cash assistance as well. Young people with lived experience helped craft the bill to ensure that it meets the real needs of our unhoused neighbors. In the richest country in the history of the world, our communities should have what they need, like access to housing and clean water. I will continue demanding our government stop sending billions of dollars to weapons contractors and the Israeli military, and instead invest in our communities. \*\*ABOUT NELLA\*\*

<-

\*\* New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. \*\*

Peter,

In less than one month, our first 2024 primary fight will take place in
Pennsylvania, where Justice Democrats incumbent Rep. Summer Lee will face
off against a so-called Democratic challenger taking money from
Republicans and Moderate PAC, a group bankrolled by Republican megadonors.

In fact, Moderate PAC recently launched the very first attack ads of the
cycle against Summer this month, fueled by the richest man in
Pennsylvania: Republican billionaire Jeff Yass.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240329-sl.Jj3RG_&refcode=em20240329-34053&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34053%2E1203867%2ExP7TGx ]The Intercept: GOP megadonor’s PAC fires off first ads in Summer Lee’s

made it his mission to defund public education, prevent higher taxes on
the rich, and ban abortion in PA. In order to succeed in advancing this
right-wing agenda, he’s trying to push Summer out of office.

If you have to rely on a Super PAC bankrolled by Pennsylvania’s richest
Republican, you’re not just unfit to run in a Democratic primary, you’re
actively anti-democracy too.

Summer’s opponent is relying on dark money and right-wing millionaires and

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

name: Senator Lashrecse Aird
subject: 2024 Session Wrap Up & Looking Ahead to Reconvened
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Friends of Lashrecse Aird
body:
logo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Screen%20Shot%202023-11-12%20at%207.15.37%20PM.png]
March 9 marked the official end of the 60-day 2024 General Assembly Session. As I reflect on this date—marking “sine die” (pronounced sigh-knee dye), and March generally when I formally launched my campaign for Senate a year ago—I was struck with sincere gratitude for the opportunity to once again fight for policies that will uplift the communities I represent. The amazing team I had working alongside me allowed us to hit the ground running with impactful issues, representative of the need we see in our district and broadly supported when successful. In addition, they took your calls, responded to your letters and emails, and helped arrange your visits to the capitol this session.
I offer a tremendous thank you to—Jameson Babb, my Chief of Staff, Dani Girardi, my Legislative Aide, Brandy Barnes, my Administrative Assistant and our collegiate fellows, Ahmir Nathan (VCU), and Solenne Montgomery (VSU).
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/March/Screenshot%202024-03-29%20at%201.55.18%E2%80%AFPM.png]
https://www.facebook.com/airdcampaign [https://www.facebook.com/airdcampaign] https://twitter.com/lashrecseaird [https://twitter.com/lashrecseaird] https://www.instagram.com/lashrecseaird/ [https://www.instagram.com/lashrecseaird/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2830%29.png] Governor’s Actions and Looking Ahead to Reconvened
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/March/Screenshot%202024-03-29%20at%202.00.44%E2%80%AFPM.png]
With more than a thousand individual bills [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+lst+SGN] reaching final passage, Governor Youngkin has already begun exercising his power and has approved [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+lst+APP] 264 bills vetoed [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+lst+VET] 88, and amended [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+lst+REC] 20 of the bills we’ve sent him. The Governor has several actions he can take with the remaining:

The Governor must act on all bills by April 8, ahead of our required Reconvened Session to occur on April 17th.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2831%29.png] Putting Families with Parental Caregivers First:
I want to amplify SB488 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?ses=241&typ=bil&val=sb488] which is also awaiting the Governor’s signature and directs the Department of Medical Assistance to apply for waivers and consider removing burdensome regulation that prevents parents from receiving compensation as caretakers for their developmental disability waiver recipient children. I can’t express the number of parents who contacted me with personal experiences about how the current structure of this process has been especially difficult for them.
With the delay in the regulations that were scheduled to go into effect earlier this month, this legislation will now allow new flexibility that will make the lives of so many parents more manageable. This outcome is largely due to the consistent advocacy of many families. Take a look as I discuss this further with WTKR’s Erin Miller in her news coverage. [https://www.wtkr.com/news/problem-solvers/virginias-medicaid-program-pauses-changes-for-parents-acting-as-paid-caregivers]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/March/Screenshot%202024-03-29%20at%202.05.02%E2%80%AFPM.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2830%29.png] Setting the Record Straight About Our Budget
As previously mentioned, one of the primary responsibilities of the General Assembly during a legislative session is to enact a balanced budget. I am proud that under Democratic leadership we not only sent a bipartisan supported, balanced budget to the Governor, but we did so on time and with our priorities intact. There has been a lot of misinformation spread about the budget we sent to the Governor, primarily by him. The reality is, this is a historic budget for workers, families, our schools and to ensure healthcare is affordable.
We took his original tax proposal which would have raised taxes on people with low incomes while giving tax breaks to millionaires and instead created a budget that makes sure more Virginians keep more of what they earn, make investments in our schools especially to combat learning loss, through mental health supports, and so much more.
We shared our budget amendments that were in the Senate budget, but I am even more proud of the critical investments we championed that are in the final budget before the Governor. A few include:

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2832%29.png] Town Hall on Petersburg Casino – April 14
On April 14, at 2:00 PM at the Petersburg Public Library, I will convene each of the potential companies seeking to develop the resort destination casino in Petersburg. This town hall will give Petersburg residents the opportunity to engage with potential operators and see their presentations featuring their vision for the development. Legislation is awaiting the Governor’s signature to allow for a referendum in November. Citizens will then have the final vote on whether a casino becomes a reality.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/March/Screenshot%202024-03-29%20at%202.08.20%E2%80%AFPM.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2832%29.png] Women’s History Month
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/March/Screenshot%202024-03-29%20at%202.10.09%E2%80%AFPM.png]
As we wrap up Women’s History Month, I could not be prouder of the women leaders I work alongside. The General Assembly saw a record number of women in both bodies and in roles to truly have an impact. Virginians not only elected us but sent us with a mandate to advance women’s rights, prioritize women’s maternal health, protect reproductive access and ensure economic opportunity. As we take a moment to reflect on the generations of women before us who fought to secure our freedoms, I am proud to say this generation of women are continuing that work. Some of that work has looked like:

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2833%29.png] Bringing REVIVE! Training To the District
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/March/Screenshot%202024-03-29%20at%202.12.12%E2%80%AFPM.png]
Last month the Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services (DBHDS) facilitated Rapid REVIVE! training sessions. REVIVE! is the Opioid Overdose and Naloxone Education (OONE) program for the Commonwealth of Virginia, which provides training on how to recognize and respond to an opioid overdose emergency using naloxone. Knowing how to administer life-saving medication in these emergency situations is an occurrence we all hope to never find ourselves in but happens with increasing frequency and can make the difference in whether an individual lives or dies. I am grateful for DBHBS making this life saving training available. I look forward to bringing this training to our district, but for now you can learn more about fentanyl [https://www.vdh.virginia.gov/drug-overdose-data/] and naloxone [https://www.vdh.virginia.gov/naloxone/] here.
I will miss sitting alongside my colleagues that represent parts of Henrico and Richmond in the chamber, but I am more excited to get back out into the district and engage with you! While the legislative session has concluded, our work on your behalf has not. We continue to be accessible by phone at 804-452-7076, email at senatoraird@senate.virginia.gov [senatoraird@senate.virginia.gov] if we can ever be of any assistance to you. For additional resources, you may also visit my website at lashrecseaird.com.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/March/Screenshot%202024-03-29%20at%202.12.59%E2%80%AFPM.png]
Thank you again for the opportunity to serve as your Senator!

Knowing how to administer life-saving medication in these emergency situations is an occurrence we all hope to never find ourselves in but happens with increasing frequency and can make the difference in whether an individual lives or dies. I am grateful for DBHBS making this life saving training available. I look forward to bringing this training to our district, but for now you can learn more about fentanyl [] and naloxone [] here. I will miss sitting alongside my colleagues that represent parts of Henrico and Richmond in the chamber, but I am more excited to get back out into the district and engage with you! While the legislative session has concluded, our work on your behalf has not. We continue to be accessible by phone at 804-452-7076, email at senatoraird@senate.virginia.gov [senatoraird@senate.virginia.gov] if we can ever be of any assistance to you. For additional resources, you may also visit my website at lashrecseaird.com. [] Thank you again for the opportunity to serve as your Senator! #

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240329-2-30&t=1&akid=7859%2E3935704%2EMg9Yho)

Hi there, it’s Gabby Giffords. I know that you’re busy, so I’ll try to keep this brief. But I wanted to reach out to you personally because as I began my day this morning, I found myself thinking about my recovery journey and the GIFFORDS community.
Thirteen years ago, I was shot in the head while meeting with constituents in Tucson, Arizona. I’ve been in recovery every single day since. I often think about my recovery the same way I think about our movement to end gun violence: some days are more difficult than others.
It hasn’t been an easy journey for me, but even on my darkest days, I’ve refused to give up hope. Today, I encourage you to take a moment to renew your hope that we can and will have a future someday where everyone is safer from gun violence.
This work is challenging. Believe me, I feel that struggle right alongside you. But the fights worth having are rarely easy. That’s why we can never, ever give up.
I know my team has been reaching out to you about our March FEC fundraising deadline. It’s coming up very quickly, and we have a lot of ground to make up if we’re going to reach the big goals we’ve set to start the election year off strong and continue our lifesaving work.

body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/maherforcongress/opening-day-12788919?e=1722d05e10)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend,

Typically, I write you asking for assistance with my campaign for Congress. However, today, I will instead reflect on the important commemoration those of the Christian faith observe as we reflect on the ultimate act of life and sacrifice demonstrated by Jesus Christ.

On Good Friday, Christians remember God's grace and promise of redemption. As many of you know, my father, John Maher, is the pastor at Calvary Chapel Church in Tulare. I grew up in the church. Easter weekend, beginning with Good Friday, has always been a special remembrance for our family, culminating in the Sunday Easter celebration.

The faith that my wife and I have and are now nurturing in our two boys, is essential to who we are. Our Constitution protects religious liberty, not just for Christians but for people of all faiths. It is one of our fundamental rights and one we must protect and preserve. So today, I want to take this opportunity to wish all of you a very happy and blessed Easter weekend.

Thank you, as always, for your support and prayers. Let's celebrate the freedom, right, and opportunity we all have to gather and worship.

Sincerely,
---
|
---
| **Michael Maher**
Businessman | Veteran | Republican for Congress
---
|

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

body:
Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots. I think that anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.
I won’t ever forget it, Peter.

Standing on the House floor. Hearing shouts, pounding, breaking glass. Barricading the door, teaching my colleagues how to use their gas masks. Texting my staff, telling them to hide.

I carried a rifle in Iraq and all I had to defend myself on January 6th was a pen. But I was ready to fight.

And after that day, Trump’s loyalists crawled right back to him. Witnessing them reject what they lived through, watching them ignore the testimony of the police officers that defended us that day while they were beaten, bloodied, pepper sprayed, cursed at... it makes me sick.

Kari Lake thinks the January Sixers are patriots who were “invited in” — she even campaigns with them.

I think anyone who supports those terrorists and traitors shouldn’t be allowed anywhere near the U.S. Senate.

This race in Arizona is just me and her. It’s on us to stop her march to more power and influence. Whoever wins in Arizona is going to determine which party holds the Senate, and could even decide whether Trump takes back the White House.

I need you with me, and I need you to take this race seriously.

## **Why I Support Reproductive Rights**
---
Hi Peter,My [own personal experience](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66072ee7f569db7aa4a10542&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tanyafortx27.com%2Fjenna%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66072cd4b036c535ab5cec17%26ss_email_id%3D66072ee7f569db7aa4a10542%26ss_campaign_name%3DWhy%2BI%2BSupport%2BReproductive%2BRights%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-03-29T21%253A13%253A30Z&w=658f0ec36f3fe00284167a1e&c=b_66072cd4b036c535ab5cec17&l=en-US&s=jx6krws1-qWhckqDXVLlQEa7ckc%3D) of having my daughter, Jenna, born 10 weeks premature changed my views on abortion: _No government official or politician should be involved in such a personal and difficult decision. _After the fall of Roe v. Wade, women’s reproductive rights are in jeopardy across TX-27 and the entire nation. **Unfortunately, this extreme anti-woman agenda is fully backed by my opponent – Michael Cloud. **During his time in office, he has supported a ban on life-saving reproductive care, has attacked our LGBT+ neighbors, and now he is working to ban In Vitro Fertilization (IVF), a scientific miracle that has given the gift of parenthood to many who couldn’t otherwise conceive.I have spoken with women in Goliad, TX who are terrified of [new extreme county laws](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66072ee7f569db7aa4a10542&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.texastribune.org%2F2023%2F10%2F23%2Fabortion-travel-ban-lubbock-county%2F&w=658f0ec36f3fe00284167a1e&c=b_66072cd4b036c535ab5cec17&l=en-US&s=hog08ZNgLEmA4Us-QCw92l4LfQY%3D) restricting the freedom of travel and placing a cloud of fear over the county.I have spoken with women in Luling, TX who are deeply concerned about the lack of high-quality healthcare options, especially for women’s healthcare. Michael Cloud is advancing dangerous policies and is too extreme for the voters of TX-27.
**It’s time for more compassionate representation, and I need your help to get out the message that Roe v. Wade must be codified into law. **Please chip in to help fuel our campaign for reproductive justice. My story of having Jenna 10 weeks premature is one I need your help to spread. Together we can change the narrative on abortion and welcome more people into standing up for women’s reproductive care.

Peter, it's Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. In case you haven't heard, I'm the Democrat running to defeat Rick Scott in Florida. I'm also an immigrant from Ecuador, a gun safety advocate, a former Congresswoman, and a proud mom. **I'm about to ask you to make a donation to support my campaign.** [**_(If you're ready to give now, you can click here to split a gift between my campaign and Maxwell Frost.)_**](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/KeNV4SrCl2qW49IgklXaOQ~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRn6bgGP0TQaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1kbXAtc3BsaXQ_cmVmY29kZT0yMDI0MDMyOV9lbV9mcl9iMV9kbXBzcGxpdF9lbiZhbW91bnQ9MjcmY2RtYz0yZU5TNUJVS3FvQ1dMWUZpVTRlR0h2aEViTjMmcmVmY29kZTI9MmVOUzVCVUtxb0NXTFlGaVU0ZUdIdmhFYk4zJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJlTlM1QlVLcW9DV0xZRmlVNGVHSHZoRWJOM1cDc3BjQgpmBAYzB2ZqOicfUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAaQ~~) But first, let me explain why I'm asking and what's at stake:
* Rick Scott is one of the most dangerous senators in Washington. He wrote the plan to **raise taxes** on working families and **end Medicare and Social Security.** And he’s supported a **nationwide ban on abortions.**

name: David Hogg
subject: I’m deeply worried about us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Hey friend – thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important.
You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place. Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an even greater and more long-term threat - hopelessness .
When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No, all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work.
I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better.
We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them.
For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business.
The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate.
We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation.
Here’s our plan:
*
Find
young
progressives
who
are
willing
to
run
for
Congress
and
state
legislatures.
*
Equip
their
campaigns
with
messaging,
scheduling,
and
budget
tools
they
need
to
win.
*
And
most
importantly,
raise
funds
from
our
massive
national
network
(hey,
that’s
you!)
to
allow
them
to
go
toe-to-toe
with
their
opponents
and
WIN.
Friend, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve.
But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country.
Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work.
– If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more -- split with Serve America. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd?amount=500]
– If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that) split with Serve America. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd?recurring=1&amount=25]
– If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford -- split with Serve America. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
– Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause.
I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change.
If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today.
- David Hogg

This is a bit of a long email, but I think it’s worth the read. **[Then if you can, please chip in to help us power our critical work here at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81945924/463981231/1889669143?refcode=ea.f63e0298-16ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ms=ea.f63e0298-16ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY2M2UwMjk4LTE2ZWUtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dgC0A6q5TVZEhV3jAvLd-vrqjRFuSFqfNXfvs6wD9Nc=)** Last week I stood on a soccer field in Ladera Heights, right next to the Inglewood Oil Field — the nation’s largest urban drilling site. I was surrounded by community members, activists, and some familiar faces like Arnold Schwarzenegger and Governor Gavin Newsom. **Together, we spoke out against Big Oil’s latest attack on our health and safety.** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81945925/463981232/1889669143?refcode=ea.f63e0298-16ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ms=ea.f63e0298-16ee-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY2M2UwMjk4LTE2ZWUtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=dgC0A6q5TVZEhV3jAvLd-vrqjRFuSFqfNXfvs6wD9Nc=) See, California passed a historic bill in 2022 that bans oil drilling within 3,200 feet of our schools, parks, and homes. It was a huge win for climate activists and frontline communities. But of course, Big Oil didn’t like it one bit. Now, they’re deploying a multi-million dollar campaign to deceive voters into thinking that oil rigs belong behind homes and pre-schools. It shows just how far they'll go to prioritize profits over people. Hearing the stories from those who have been directly impacted truly hit home for me. Stories of families living in the shadow of pumpjacks, of children playing beside toxic drill sites. Oil companies are making these communities sacrifice zones. It’s a heartbreaking reality for too many Californians. And it's why we’re fighting tooth and nail to defeat Big Oil again. The truth is that Big Oil is using California as a testing ground, spending millions to get a referendum on the ballot this November that would subvert the will of the people and take us backward. Your support will help us counter Big Oil’s playbook, not just in California, but across the country. Now, here's the role you play in this fight: **We're in the midst of an ambitious end-of-quarter fundraising push. Thanks to an anonymous donor, every contribution you make by March 31st will be matched up to $15,000.** **[Please, if you've ever felt moved by our cause, let this be the moment you act. body:
I want to explain the importance of having a strong financial showing on our FEC reports and what it means for the future of El Paso County. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/614ad3ea81f6/river-gassen-newsletter-8253246?e=3818d77efc)
---

This isn't the first or last email you'll receive asking you to donate before the end-of-quarter FEC deadline. But deadlines like this are important to campaigns like ours.

[If you're ready to make a donation now to help reach our goal and elect River, click here to chip in $25!](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=45d99636ec&e=3818d77efc)
Each FEC deadline is a chance to show the strength of our campaign. The amount we raise by midnight on March 31 and the number of individual donors will be a matter of public record. With a crowded field, this is our chance to set ourselves apart.
Dave “Let’s Go Brandon” Williams has used his position in the Colorado GOP to cheat and all but guarantee his spot as the Republican candidate. He will be free to start fundraising Trump money for the general election. He will do everything in his power to out fundraise us.

This is our chance to show them we have what it takes to win this race! [So please, chip in $25 now to flip El Paso County Blue.](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=0b40a94e99&e=3818d77efc)
These quarterly fundraising numbers help us budget and strategize for the race ahead. Your support now will help us build the massive operation we need to flip this seat.
[I know we can make up the gap before the end-of-quarter FEC deadline and show MAGA Republicans that we will win this seat. So please, chip in now to elect River in Colorado and help Democrats retake the House!](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=ed596ece72&e=3818d77efc)
