name: Josh Harder
subject: An important decision
body:
I need your help to make it.

Hi Peter -
Happy Friday, I just got out of a meeting with my campaign team and wanted to share a few takeaways with you.
**Where we stand:** This Sunday is our first end-of-quarter deadline of the general election. Right now we’re falling short of our $15,000 goal. If you can afford to donate and help us win this competitive race, I would greatly appreciate it. Here is the [_**link**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81947224/463985510/2012216730?&refcode=E7795-20240329-ImportantDecision-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2I5MTRhYmYtMTllZS1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Ewe_TRTuJnIbrUCKLc8tW2sfpL4goBO04rbS27Ztleo=).
**Why this goal matters:** This deadline is a big deal because it’s the first time this year we’ll report our fundraising to the Federal Election Commission. If our fundraising numbers are low, it sends a bright flashing light to our extreme GOP opponent and to national Republicans that we’re in trouble. It also directly impacts some big budget decisions we have coming up.
**What decisions we need to make:** One of our strategic advantages last cycle was how early we invested in grassroots organizing, especially latino outreach. It meant we spoke to voters early and often (and in-language). I absolutely want to make that early field investment again. However, that hiring is dependent upon us hitting this end-of-quarter goal.
**Other considerations:** Outside money is always a huge threat in this toss-up seat. After a new poll showed us down by 4 points, we’re expecting to face at least six figures (or more) in attack ads. We have to match the Republicans dollar for dollar in spending in order to combat their negative ads. If they spend $500,000 on attack ads against me, we have to spend $500,000 back. It’s that simple.
**What I need from this team:** Well, I need your help hitting this important fundraising goal! If we fall short, the GOP will have a huge advantage because we won’t be able to get our field organizing started or have enough resources to fight back against their negative ads.
That’s why I’m asking you to please send in a donation today before our deadline. It’s the only thing that’s going to help us come out on top.
Here is my personal link: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-March2024-FR-March**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81947225/463985511/2012216730?&refcode=E7795-20240329-ImportantDecision-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2I5MTRhYmYtMTllZS1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Ewe_TRTuJnIbrUCKLc8tW2sfpL4goBO04rbS27Ztleo=)
Thank you for everything you are doing to protect our democracy. It means the world to have supporters like you who have my back during critical moments like this!
\- Josh

Josh Harder for Congress
PO Box 4220
Manteca, CA 95337
United States

| | |

Hello,

For nearly five decades, I’ve been working to understand and tell the story of America through film.
Throughout the history of our nation, crises like the Civil War, the Great Depression, the First and Second World Wars, and the COVID-19 pandemic have threatened the American promise – challenging us to fight for our democratic system of government in a way that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.

Today, it’s once again time for us to come together to stand with the leaders fighting for our democracy – leaders like Senator Jacky Rosen.
That’s why I’m reaching out today: **[Will you join me in contributing whatever you can to help Jacky reach her critical $100,000 end-of-quarter goal and win her tough reelection fight in Nevada?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81947443/463986224/1553268835?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3631-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTMwZTU3YS0xYWVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zKPkRvRrd5HyW1e4ov56Yq7XE-urQVZEtgAPyh8mZJI=)**
Jacky is the most vulnerable Democratic woman in the Senate, and experts predict that her race will likely decide Senate control. That’s why dark money groups are pouring money into Nevada to defeat her.

We cannot afford to lose a voice like Jacky’s in the Senate. She’s been tirelessly working to make a difference for hardworking families across the country, to defend fundamental reproductive rights, and to uphold our democracy in the face of unprecedented attacks. But to continue these vital fights, she needs the immediate support of people like you.
**Right now, polls show her race in Nevada locked neck and neck. If Jacky is going to have the resources she needs to pull ahead and win, she cannot afford to fall short of her upcoming end-of-quarter goal.[So please, friend, join me now in supporting Jacky Rosen’s reelection campaign in Nevada to uphold our Senate majority, our fundamental freedoms, and our democracy.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81947444/463986225/1553268835?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3631-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTMwZTU3YS0xYWVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zKPkRvRrd5HyW1e4ov56Yq7XE-urQVZEtgAPyh8mZJI=)**
Thank you,

He’s already spent millions of his own money on attack ads in the last few months. But I know from experience that if grassroots supporters like you chip in whatever they can, we can pull off the unthinkable.

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81948360/463989138/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDBlYmE0YS0xZmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8jehIvR5uQSnrIjA_WMOLz4AKcUz9GMOLQSEKT56KUM=) Hey — I’m sure your inbox is flooded right now with campaigns asking for your support before Saturday’s big FEC deadline, so first, let me apologize for adding to your email clutter. You might be wondering, is this deadline really such a big deal, or is it just an email gimmick? And truthfully, this deadline really matters, and our campaign is taking it very seriously — because whether or not we meet our goal before Sunday will tangibly impact our odds of holding this must-win seat. [_**If that’s all the explanation you need, then I’d be so grateful if you could pitch in a few dollars before the deadline.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81948361/463989139/1393271644?refcode=email_032924_Five-reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDBlYmE0YS0xZmVlLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8jehIvR5uQSnrIjA_WMOLz4AKcUz9GMOLQSEKT56KUM=) But if you need more context for why this deadline really matters, which is absolutely fair, please keep reading! **Here are five big reasons why this is such a critical time for our campaign to raise money:** **1) Our fundraising numbers for the year so far will be made public after Sunday.** If our numbers show any sign of weakness, our opponents and the super PACs backing them will seize on it — and pour even _more_ money into Kansas to try and defeat me. **2) If we don’t hit our goal, we’re going to have to make some very tough budgeting decisions.** To win a race in a district this competitive, we need to get our message out to every single voter in person, over the phone, on TV, and online. But doing that takes resources, and if we get off track, we’re going to have to run fewer TV ads, knock on fewer doors, and, overall, run a less effective campaign. _I don’t want to look back on Nov. 6 and wish we’d turned out just a few more voters to push us across the finish line._ **3) We’re already facing misleading attacks.** If you feel like the election cycle seems to start earlier and earlier, you’re right! I’m frustrated by that too. Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

subject: Millions of dollars against Summer and Jamaal
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
AIPAC is ready to spend millions of dollars to try and oust Alexandria and the Squad this year — **and they are starting with Jamaal Bowman and Summer Lee.**
The right-wing, pro-Israel lobbyist group takes huge donations from Trump mega-donors and targets progressive candidates, generally of color, who speak out for Palestinian human rights.
Last cycle, AIPAC spent $5 million against Summer. This year, they have already donated $600,000 to Jamaal’s opponent.
Summer and Jamaal are strong progressive voices in Congress, fighting for peace and humanity. Standing with them is about justice. It’s about community. It’s about what we want the Democratic Party — and our democracy — to look like.
**Summer and Jamaal need your support before Sunday’s critical EOQ fundraising deadline in just two days.** Alexandria and our team have supported their campaigns before through attacks from AIPAC, and we need your help to do it again.
[Will you join AOC in supporting Summer and Jamaal today by splitting a contribution directly between their two campaigns? We can’t let AIPAC defeat our growing progressive movement in Congress.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240329-2.paSVMO&refcode=em20240329-6112-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6112%2E2526796%2EWHWDWA)

**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240329-2.paSVMO&refcode=em20240329-6112-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6112%2E2526796%2EWHWDWA)**
Whether or not you’re able to contribute today, we’re so grateful that you are a part of this movement. Thank you for standing with Summer and Jamaal.
Onward,
Team AOC
